# dsh-plugin-reactive-resume Connect [Reactive Resume](https://rxresu.me) to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Read, create, and edit your resumes and job applications from a Harness session. ## Install ```bash dsh plugin --profile add dsh-plugin-reactive-resume ``` This package declares `dsh.bundle`, so the profile picks it up as a layer and mounts it automatically. Until you configure a key it mounts nothing and logs a warning, so installing it never leaves a profile unbootable. ## Configure Mint an API key at `https://rxresu.me/dashboard/settings/api-keys` and export it as `RXRESUME_API_KEY` — the bundle patch reads that variable. To set it explicitly, or to change any other option, patch the row by id from your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: reactive-resume config: apiKey: !!js process.env.RXRESUME_API_KEY ``` ### Options | Key | Default | Description | | ------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | `apiKey` | `''` | API key from `/dashboard/settings/api-keys`. Empty mounts nothing. | | `url` | `https://rxresu.me` | Origin of your instance. Set this if you self-host. | | `serverName` | `resume` | Tool namespace. Tools reach the model as `mcp____`. | | `toolCallTimeoutMs` | `60000` | Per-tool-call timeout. | Every tool Reactive Resume publishes is exposed. Narrowing that set is not currently possible from a plugin: Harness's `ctx.tools.restrict()` requires an agent-scoped context, which a plugin context is not. ### Self-hosted ```yaml - id: reactive-resume config: apiKey: !!js process.env.RXRESUME_API_KEY url: http://localhost:3000 ``` ## What it does Bridges Reactive Resume's MCP server into `ctx.tools`, and contributes a system-prompt section covering the things models get wrong about resume editing: reading before patching, RFC 6902 path construction against the published schema, UUID-keyed section entries, and locked resumes. You could wire the bridge yourself with a raw `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row. What you cannot do that way is contribute the prompt section — that is what this package adds. ## Harness compatibility The peer ranges list each supported DSH host line as an explicit `||` union: `^0.1.0-rc.6` (what this package already shipped against) plus `^0.2.0-rc.1` (which admits `0.2.0-rc.1` and `0.2.0-rc.2`). The union is purely additive — every version the old range admitted is still admitted. Every published DSH release is a prerelease, which makes the comparison mode matter: - The Harness host decides whether to mount a plugin with `semver.satisfies(runtime, range, { includePrerelease: true })`. The upper bound is what rejected the old range there: `^0.1.0-rc.6` expands to `>=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0-0`, and `0.2.0-rc.2` sorts above `0.2.0-0` because the numeric identifier `0` precedes `rc`. - npm's default mode — the one the plugin market's checker uses — additionally requires a comparator set to pin the same `major.minor.patch` tuple with a prerelease of its own. Under that mode the bare `^0.1.0-rc.6` admits only `0.1.0-rc.6` through `0.1.0-rc.8`. Measured against all 29 published host releases, that gap is wide: `^0.1.0-rc.6` admits 22 of them under the host's mode (every `0.1.x` line, including `0.1.5-rc.2` and `0.1.7-rc.2`) but only 3 under npm's default mode. Widening the upper bound does not close it, because the default mode ignores the widened comparator: `>=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.3.0-0` still admits only those same 3, and `*` admits none at all. `^0.1.0-rc.6 || ^0.2.0-rc.1` admits 24 releases under the host's mode and 5 under the default one, so an explicit union member per host line is the only form both checkers agree on. Against `0.2.0-rc.2` this package needed no source change: `dsh-mcp-client@0.2.0-rc.2` keeps its `Config` union, its `apply(ctx, config)` signature, and the `mcp____` public tool name, while `dsh-system-prompt@0.2.0-rc.2` keeps `section({ name, order, text })`. What 0.2.0 adds to the bridge — MCP resource publishing and a server-instructions prompt section — is additive and scoped to `ctx.inject(["mcpResources"])` / `ctx.inject(["systemPrompt"])`, neither of which this package depends on. ## Development This package lives in the [Reactive Resume monorepo](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume) at `packages/dsh-plugin`, next to `packages/mcp` — the server it bridges. `src/tool-names.test.ts` checks every tool the prompt guide names against `@reactive-resume/mcp/tool-names`, so renaming a tool breaks this package in the same pull request. ```bash pnpm --filter dsh-plugin-reactive-resume test pnpm --filter dsh-plugin-reactive-resume build ``` ## License MIT > [!IMPORTANT] > Reactive Resume now lives at **[`reactive-resume/reactive-resume`](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume)** on GitHub. > GHCR images publish to `ghcr.io/reactive-resume/reactive-resume`. > Docker Hub stays at `amruthpillai/reactive-resume`.

Reactive Resume

Reactive Resume is a free and open-source resume builder for writing resumes and cover letters, checking your work, and tracking job applications.

Get Started · Learn More

Sponsored by

--- Create a free account, import an existing resume or start fresh, and see the finished page as you write. Download a PDF, Word, Markdown, or JSON file, or share your resume with a public link. You can also run the whole application on your own infrastructure. You own your data. The codebase is open source under the MIT license, with no tracking, no ads, and no paid tier. Optional AI features use a provider you connect; hosting and provider usage may have their own costs. ![Reactive Resume v6 editor with Write, Design, and Check modes and a live PDF preview](docs/images/getting-started/editor-overview.webp) ## Build a better resume, together [Join the Reactive Resume community on Discord](https://discord.gg/u9pAd3za9t) to exchange resume feedback, get help using or self-hosting the app, and share ideas with other users and contributors. - **Resume feedback:** post a redacted resume and one specific question, or help someone improve theirs. - **Help:** find troubleshooting discussions and ask questions in dedicated forum threads. - **Contribute:** discuss ideas, translations, and code with the people building Reactive Resume. Feedback comes from fellow community members. Remove contact details and other private information before posting. ## Features **Write, Design, and Check** - Redesigned editor with inline content editing and click-to-select on the page - Live PDF preview and browser downloads powered by Forme, rendered in a background worker - Rich text, custom sections, drag-and-drop ordering, and structured dates with consistent formatting - Autosave, local recovery of unsaved resume drafts, and up to 200 undo steps - Phone and tablet layouts, keyboard shortcuts, and a searchable command bar **Templates and Customization** - 18 templates, including the new Porygon and Smeargle, previewed with your own content - One-column, two-column, and ATS-safe template filters - Font presets, custom fonts, colors, spacing, A4 and Letter paper, and left or right sidebars - Fit overflowing content by adjusting density, margins, and text size - Custom Styles written as Semantic CSS, with an element picker on the page **Resume Checks** - Readability checks with findings pinned to the relevant lines - Job-posting keyword matching and a view of the text hiring software reads - Checks on the exported PDF, plus an optional AI writing review - A public [ATS checker](https://rxresu.me/ats-checker) that reads PDFs in your browser without an account **Documents and Cover Letters** - One searchable library for resumes and letters, with tags, sorting, and grid or list views - Standalone cover letters with their own editor, exports, and version history - Link a letter to a resume to keep its sender details and design in sync, or customize it independently - Automatic and named versions you can preview and restore - Trash with Undo and a 30-day recovery window **Job Applications** - List, Board, Insights, and Calendar views for tracking applications from Saved to Offer - Save jobs from a URL or pasted posting; optional keyword search through Firecrawl, Tavily, or Exa - Tailor a resume and draft a cover letter for a saved job - Track contacts, notes, follow-ups, application outcomes, and the documents you sent - Schedule interviews, export calendar events, and import or export applications as CSV **AI Assistant** - Assistant beside your resume or letter, with conversations tied to that document - Proposed edits show what changes and why; accept or reject each suggestion - Improve selected text, review writing, and draft letters from a resume and job posting - Connect OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama, or other supported providers and compatible endpoints - Optional web search and page reading; self-hosters can configure shared AI and web-access providers **Import, Export, and Sharing** - Import Reactive Resume JSON, JSON Resume, LinkedIn data exports, PDF, and Word files - JSON, LinkedIn, and readable PDF imports work without AI; Word imports require a connected provider - Export resumes and letters as PDF, Word (DOCX), Markdown, or JSON - Share resumes through public links with optional password protection and view/download statistics - REST API and MCP server for document management, imports, exports, checks, and application workflows **Privacy and Control** - Self-host with Docker, Vercel, Cloudflare Workers, or a 1-click deploy on Hostinger - No tracking or ads; export your account data or delete your account - Passkeys, two-factor authentication, and linked sign-in providers - Multiple interface languages, light/dark/system themes, and reduced-motion support ## Templates

For a deployment using published images, follow the [Docker guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/docker). For source development, see the [development setup guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/contributing/development). ## Tech Stack | Category | Technology | | ---------------- | ---------------------------------------- | | Web app | React 19 SPA, TanStack Router, and Vite | | Server | Hono on Node.js 24 or Cloudflare Workers | | Language | TypeScript | | Monorepo | pnpm and Turborepo | | Database | PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM | | API | oRPC, OpenAPI REST, and MCP | | Auth | Better Auth | | Styling | Tailwind CSS | | UI Components | Base UI + shared UI package | | State Management | Zustand + TanStack Query | | PDF rendering | Forme, with PDF.js for the viewer | | Rich text | TipTap | | Localization | Lingui | ## Documentation The full documentation lives at [docs.rxresu.me](https://docs.rxresu.me): | Guide | Description | | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | | [Getting started](https://docs.rxresu.me/getting-started) | First-time setup and basic usage | | [What's new in v6](https://docs.rxresu.me/guides/whats-new-in-v6) | Changes and where familiar features moved | | [Checking your resume](https://docs.rxresu.me/guides/checking-your-resume) | Readability, job match, and writing reviews | | [Using the assistant](https://docs.rxresu.me/guides/using-the-assistant) | Ask for changes and review proposed edits | | [Resume and career agent skills](plugins/reactive-resume/README.md) | 32 skills for resume writing, specific roles and the job search | | [Writing a cover letter](https://docs.rxresu.me/guides/writing-a-cover-letter) | Create a letter and link it to a resume | | [Tracking job applications](https://docs.rxresu.me/guides/tracking-job-applications) | Saved jobs, stages, interviews, and insights | | [Exporting your resume](https://docs.rxresu.me/guides/exporting-your-resume) | PDF, Word, Markdown, and JSON downloads | | [API](https://docs.rxresu.me/guides/using-the-api) and [MCP](https://docs.rxresu.me/guides/using-the-mcp-server) | Connect scripts and external assistants | | [Self-hosting](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/docker) | Deploy on your own infrastructure | | [Migrating from v5](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/upgrading-to-v6) | Migrations and integration changes | | [Development setup](https://docs.rxresu.me/contributing/development) | Local development environment | | [Project architecture](https://docs.rxresu.me/contributing/architecture) | Codebase structure and package boundaries | ## Self-Hosting Reactive Resume runs the same application everywhere: PostgreSQL for data, plus storage for uploads. Pick the option that fits how much you want to manage. | Option | Best for | Guide | | ----------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | [Hostinger](#hostinger) | A ready-made VPS with no setup | [Hostinger guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/hostinger) | | [Vercel](#vercel) | Serverless, with managed database and storage | [Vercel guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/vercel) | | [Cloudflare Workers](#cloudflare-workers) | Workers, R2 and your own PostgreSQL | [Cloudflare guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/cloudflare) | | [Docker and Kubernetes](#docker-and-kubernetes) | Your own server, homelab or cluster | [Docker](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/docker) · [Kubernetes](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/kubernetes) | > **PDF generation in v6** uses Forme in the browser and on the server. No Browserless, Chromium, or external print service is needed. Legacy `PRINTER_*` and `BROWSERLESS_*` environment variables can be removed. ### Hostinger The quickest way to get going is a 1-click deploy on Hostinger, starting at $6.49/month. Their VPS plans include a ready-made Reactive Resume template that provisions the Docker environment and brings the app up for you, with weekly backups and a Docker manager UI included — so you can skip the setup entirely. See the [Hostinger guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/hostinger) for what the template sets up and what to configure afterwards, such as email, your own domain, and turning off sign-ups. ### Vercel [![Deploy with Vercel](https://vercel.com/button)](https://vercel.com/new/clone?repository-url=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Freactive-resume%2Freactive-resume&project-name=reactive-resume&repository-name=reactive-resume&env=AUTH_SECRET%2CENCRYPTION_SECRET&envDescription=Generate+two+independent+secrets+with+openssl+rand+-hex+32.+Keep+these+values+across+deployments.&envLink=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.rxresu.me%2Fself-hosting%2Fvercel&stores=%5B%7B%22type%22%3A%22integration%22%2C%22protocol%22%3A%22storage%22%2C%22integrationSlug%22%3A%22neon%22%2C%22productSlug%22%3A%22neon%22%7D%2C%7B%22type%22%3A%22integration%22%2C%22protocol%22%3A%22storage%22%2C%22integrationSlug%22%3A%22upstash%22%2C%22productSlug%22%3A%22upstash-kv%22%7D%2C%7B%22type%22%3A%22blob%22%2C%22access%22%3A%22private%22%7D%5D) Vercel provisions Neon PostgreSQL, private Blob storage, and Upstash Redis through its deployment wizard. Supply two persistent secrets and use the **Services** framework preset. Static assets run in the frontend service, and Hono serves the application routes and APIs from the backend service. See the [Vercel guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/vercel) for setup, limits, and optional SMTP/OAuth configuration. ### Cloudflare Workers Cloudflare deployment requires **Workers Paid** and uses Static Assets, private R2 storage, SQLite Durable Objects, and PostgreSQL through Hyperdrive. Supply an existing PostgreSQL database and apply migrations before deployment. See the [Cloudflare guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/cloudflare) for setup and runtime limits. ### Docker and Kubernetes The application needs: - **PostgreSQL** — Accounts, documents, applications, and assistant conversations - **Upload storage** — A persistent local directory or an S3-compatible bucket, such as SeaweedFS - **Redis** (optional) — Shared coordination across instances and resumable assistant replies - **SMTP** (optional) — Verification and password-reset emails Published releases are available from Docker Hub and GitHub Container Registry (`latest` tracks the latest stable release): ```bash # Docker Hub docker pull amruthpillai/reactive-resume:latest # GitHub Container Registry docker pull ghcr.io/reactive-resume/reactive-resume:latest ``` See the [Docker guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/docker) or [Kubernetes guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/kubernetes) for complete instructions. Running on a NAS? See the [Synology and UGREEN guides](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/nas). ### Configuration Every setting is listed in the [environment variables reference](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/environment-variables). Self-hosters can also configure [shared AI and job-search services](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/job-search-and-ai) and [single sign-on](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/sso). ### Upgrading from v5 Back up your database and uploads and stop all v5 instances before applying v6 migrations. Old visual style rules require a manual conversion; API and MCP integrations also have changes. Follow [Migrating from v5](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/upgrading-to-v6). ## Support Reactive Resume is and always will be free and open source. If it has helped you land a job or saved you time, please consider supporting continued development:

Other ways to support: - Star this repository - Report reproducible bugs and suggest actionable features - Help other users in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/discussions/categories/q-a) - Improve documentation - Help with translations ## Star History ## Contributing Every contribution helps, whether it is a typo fix or a new feature. 1. Fork the repository 2. Create a feature branch (`git checkout -b feature/amazing-feature`) 3. Commit your changes using Conventional Commits (`git commit -m 'feat: add amazing feature'`) 4. Push to the branch (`git push origin feature/amazing-feature`) 5. Open a Pull Request See the [development setup guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/contributing/development) for how to run the project locally. Maintainers review the [`status: needs triage` queue](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3A%22status%3A+needs+triage%22) weekly. Triaged bugs become `status: confirmed`; feature proposals become `status: accepted`; reports that need details become `status: needs info`. ## License [MIT](./LICENSE) — do whatever you want with it.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
dsh-fast-mode

DeepSeek Harness 自己的 fast mode：同一个模型，只消耗一半的输出，最快快一倍。
多种开关自由组合，全在提示词侧：不换模型、不降思考强度、不写任何一个请求字段。
实测最快 0.505× 耗时、输出 token −42%、判分 438/438 全绿 —— benchmark 与复现。

English

--- ## 一眼看完 30 对完整任务、同一模型同一设置，只差三个开关： | 指标 | 结果 | |---|---| | **墙钟耗时** | **0.505×**（快约一倍，30 对 26 对更快） | | **输出 token** | **−42%**（16037 → 9380） | | **思考字符** | **−51%**（42380 → 20872） | | **任务质量** | 判分 **438/438** 全绿，30/30 运行通过 | 三个开关全开 + 面板默认项，是这套东西最快的一档；只开闪电、不开三个新开关，全池 138 对是 **0.823×**（省 18 %）。 ## 怎么装 ```bash dsh plugin install dsh-fast-mode ``` 装完在会话里点闪电。右键闪电打开八行面板，**只影响当前会话**。 ## 八个按钮在做什么 八个开关都是纯提示词侧：不加请求参数、不改模型、不改完成判定。前两个管输出，最后一个管上下文体积，中间五个管「怎么走」。 | 按钮 | 原理 | 默认 | |---|---|---| | **精简输出** | 不预告调用、不复述结果、不写进度，最终答案不缩水 | 开 | | **步数上限** | 硬上限，到点先汇报现状，不截断任务 | 不限 | | **开局附文件清单** | 开局把工作目录交给模型，省掉先跑一遍 `ls`/`find` | 关 | | **批量读文件** | 互不依赖的读取合成一批发出，少几个来回 | 关 | | **截短工具输出** | 只留头尾和报错行，长输出不再整段进上下文 | 关 | | **不确定先查证** | 拿不准就读一次；不是纯提速，省的是猜错后的重来 | 关 | | **先执行后解释** | 动手前最多一行计划；思考过 4000 字符时提醒「按证据动手」 | 关 | | **重复时换方法** | 同一调用重发、或连续三次结果一样时，提醒换条路 | 关 | 中间五个是 1.7.0 起的新机制，**默认关**，理由见下面的边界。截短工具输出 1.7.12 起进面板——它是唯一会改变模型所见证据的开关，所以默认关，且关掉就是原文。 ## Benchmark 三开关全开（`trio17`）vs 全关，同一批任务逐对比较，配对 bootstrap 4000 次： | 实验块 | 对数 | 墙钟几何均值 | 95% 区间 | 更快 | |---|---|---|---|---| | DP17 | 12 | 0.647× | [0.501, 0.893] | 10/12 | | DP18 | 9 | 0.491× | [0.314, 0.788] | 8/9 | | DP20b（发布版） | 9 | 0.372× | [0.240, 0.563] | 8/9 | | **合池** | **30** | **0.505×** | **[0.401, 0.635]** | **26/30** | 发布版那一块里，步数 13.2 → 6.7、墙钟 464.9 s → 173.1 s，三开在每一块都是唯一区间不跨 1 的臂。复现命令与原始数据在 [BENCHMARK.md](BENCHMARK.md)。 ## 为什么能快，以及哪里不会快 一步的耗时 ≈ 往返开销 × 步数 + 解码时间 × 输出 token + 工具等待。模型不在这个式子里，所以这里只动程序量：少几次往返、少几轮回头读、少写重复的编辑。 - **有些情况会变慢，别指望它全场景加速。** 1–5 步的小改修和数据整形收不回成本（`perfrefactor` 1.18×、`csvpipe` 1.12×），实现类任务偶尔多绕一步（DP20 有一对 1.04×）。 - **质量优先。** 每个采纳的批次里两臂隐藏断言逐格相同；安全校验、数据删除、无障碍这些场景永远走完整验证，不做提速。 - **开关在你手里。** 默认只开「精简输出」；三个新开关默认关，因为它们的收益按任务形状波动，不适合替所有人默认决定。 推荐：**大多数时候三个全开**。想稳一点只开「不确定先查证」；最在意思考链过长就开「先执行后解释」；「重复时换方法」单开实测等于没变（1.007×，十二个会话只触发 3 次），放在组合里无害。 ## 自己量一遍 上面的数字都来自本仓库的 bench，换到你的机器和你的任务上未必一样。先 `node audit/run.mjs --dry-run --cwd <仓库> --tasks <清单>` 看它要展开成什么命令，去掉 `--dry-run` 就是配对真跑（每任务每臂 3 轮），产物落在 `audit-out/<时间戳>/`：原始读数 `pairs.jsonl` 和带几何均值比与区间的人看报告 `report.md`。配对数不足 6 时报告只写「样本不足，不做结论」。 方法与结论边界见 [docs/AUDIT.md](docs/AUDIT.md)，清单怎么写见 [audit/tasks.example.jsonl](audit/tasks.example.jsonl)，agent 操作手册见 [skills/fast-mode-audit/SKILL.md](skills/fast-mode-audit/SKILL.md)。 ## 许可 MIT。参考手册见 [docs/REFERENCE.md](docs/REFERENCE.md)，逐版改动见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

# dsh-onebot-qq

把 QQ 接进 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）的插件：
通过 **OneBot v11** 协议连接你已经运行好的 **NapCat / SnowLuma / Lagrange.OneBot / LLOneBot**
网关，提供连接管理、账号核验、事件缓冲、消息收发，以及一个完整的 DSH Web 面板（侧栏「QQ 连接」）。

本插件是「QQ 感知与执行接入层」：只负责把 QQ 的事件带进 DSH、把动作发回 QQ。
人格、记忆、认知、防抖、策略与学习能力由本包内置的认知内核（`src/cognition/`）提供；统一模型协议网关在
`src/model/`，同时向 DSH 事件总线广播 `onebot-qq/event` / `onebot-qq/state` / `onebot-qq/config` / `onebot-qq/raw`。

- **不内置、不下载、不启动、不注入任何 QQ 网关**：只连接你填的地址。SnowLuma 模式也只读它自己的
  `config/onebot*.json`（其 EULA 限制自动化部署，见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)）。
- **零第三方运行时依赖**：宿主半边只用 Node.js 内置模块（`node:http` / `crypto` / `fetch` / `WebSocket`），
  网页半边只用 DSH 注入的 React 实例。
- **所有算法参数都可配置**：重连退避、超时、重试、核验缓冲、事件过滤、缓冲容量、日志级别……全部在
  `config.json` 里，带默认值，面板可改可重置；没有任何写死的业务常量。
- **可配置的界面与动效 +「系统设置」页**：面板的视觉令牌与语义动效参考 console-web 项目的设计体系
  （PageHeader、Panel/Card、StatusPill、soft Tabs、Viewport Reveal、Feedback Presence、trickle Progress 等）
  重新实现；第 7 个「系统设置」标签参考 console-web preferences 提供 **DSH 全局主题**、强调色、对比度、
  密度、字号、内容宽度、动效模式、页面切换动画，分类切换只替换右侧内容、不整页滑动，每次修改即时保存。
  `配置` 与 `系统设置` 都是持久设置壳；`reduced`/`off` 与系统 `prefers-reduced-motion` 双重降级
  （详见 [用户手册的系统设置章节](docs/USER-MANUAL.md#系统设置)）。
- **完整认知内核（v0.4）**：第 8 个「认知」标签，包含人格、人物、关系、记忆、情绪、策略、学习、技能、
  元认知与设置。它不是一个巨型 Prompt：长期状态全部在 SQLite（人物/关系/记忆/情绪/技能/策略/任务），
  LLM 只做语义投影与生成；轮次聚合、注意力、记忆检索、策略选择、结果归因、学习验证都有自己的算法与测试。
- **人格工作台、群聊参与与诊断（v0.6）**：顶层「人格」标签，用自然语言编辑名字、身份、背景、
  性格、说话风格、喜好/边界与示例，实时预览注入 prompt；同时提供群聊参与方式（仅@/概率/所有消息）、
  冷却与频率上限。概览与认知状态页显示最近消息是否被 gate 跳过及原因。
- **多人格库与切换（v0.7）**：可保存多份互相独立的人格，新建/复制/切换/删除；
  每份保留自己的 profile、12 维特质、风格、价值、历史与版本；activeId 持久化，切换后下一轮即生效；
  旧 `self` 自动成为默认人格，不丢历史。
- **人格级认知数据隔离与复制（v0.8）**：记忆、人物、关系、情绪、策略、学习、技能、诊断数据按当前人格
  存储；切换人格即切换整套认知状态。旧数据一次性迁移到默认人格；人格页可把来源人格的指定数据组
  单向复制到当前人格（来源不变，复制后继续独立）。
- **DSH 模型链路修复与人格导入（v0.9）**：DSH 一次性调用改为顶层 `system` + identity-free user
  messages，并带稳定 sessionId，失败会保留 provider 真实错误；新增 `/cognition/llm/test` 自检；人格页支持导入
  `persona-import@1` JSON，并附带 Aoi 蒸馏包本地转换脚本（公开仓库不转载外部人格原文）。
- **统一模型协议网关（v0.5）**：统一 OpenAI Chat/Responses、Anthropic Messages、
  Gemini generateContent、Ollama Chat；内置 OpenCode Go、Command Code、OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等预设，
  自定义 base URL/认证/headers/session/模型，支持 SSE 流式、模型发现、连通测试以及 direct/DSH/chain 路由。
  密钥独立保存在 `models.json`，不通过 `/config` 回传。详见 [MODEL-GATEWAY.md](docs/MODEL-GATEWAY.md)。
  设计与边界见 [认知架构文档](docs/cognitive/CAPABILITY-MAP.md)、[实际实现状态](docs/cognitive/IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md)
  与 [验证报告](docs/VERIFICATION.md)；未实现项在状态表中明确标 L/N。

## 能力

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 连接管理 | 正向 WebSocket（收事件）+ HTTP（调接口）；可只配 WS；断线自动重连（指数退避 + 抖动，全可配） |
| 账号核验 | 连上后调 `get_login_info` 核对 `botQQ`；`off` / `warn` / `enforce` 三档策略，核验期间事件先缓冲、通过后补发 |
| 事件缓冲 | 消息 / 通知 / 请求 / 元事件规范化（字符串 CQ 码与消息段数组都支持），环形缓冲 + 统计 + 可选 JSONL 落盘 |
| 事件过滤 | 按 QQ 号、群号、事件类型、私聊/群聊、是否包含自己发的消息过滤，全部配置驱动 |
| 消息发送 | 发私聊 / 群聊（字符串自动转 `[{type:'text'}]` 消息段，也可直接传段数组） |
| 查询 | 登录信息、好友列表、群列表、群成员信息、撤回/查询消息、网关状态/版本 |
| 调试 | HTTP 探测（`get_login_info`）；可选的原始 action 透传（默认关闭） |
| Web 面板 | 侧栏「QQ 连接」→ 整页面板：概览 / 连接 / 消息 / 配置 / 人格 / 模型 / 系统设置 / 认知 / 日志 / 关于；数据驱动配置表单、Ctrl+S 保存、dirty 提示 |
| 人格工作台 | 顶层「人格」页：多人格库（新建/复制/切换/删除）+ 名字/身份/背景/性格/说话风格/喜好/边界/示例 + prompt 预览 + 群聊参与（仅@/概率/所有消息）+ 冷却/频率上限；每份人格独立持久化 |
| 人格认知数据 | 记忆/人物/关系/情绪/策略/学习/技能/诊断按人格隔离；人格页查看各组条数，可从其他人格单向复制指定组到当前人格 |

| 模型协议 | 统一 OpenAI Chat/Responses、Anthropic Messages、Gemini generateContent、Ollama Chat；OpenCode Go、Command Code、OpenRouter、DeepSeek 预设；自定义 base/认证/headers/session；流式、模型发现、连通测试、直连/DSH/链式路由 |
| 系统设置 | 参考 console-web preferences：DSH 全局主题（浅色/深色/跟随系统）、强调色、对比度、密度、字号、内容宽度、动效、页面转场；持久设置壳 + 即时保存 + 预览 |
| 认知内核 | 轮次聚合/防抖、注意力、人格慢演化、人物画像、多维关系、情绪、工作/情景/语义/关联记忆、检索/巩固/遗忘、信念/未知、策略-结果分离、撤回专项、主动行为、学习闭环、技能/退化、元认知 |
| 学习 | 未知检测 → 学习任务 → 多来源证据 → 带引用 claim → 应用/复核；默认仅检测，自动外部检索需显式开启，支持预算/暂停/重试 |

## 环境要求

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.0 < 0.3.0`（已在 `0.2.1-rc.3` 上验证）
- Node.js `>= 22.13`（插件使用原生 `fetch` 与 `WebSocket`；认知 SQLite 使用 `node:sqlite`，无则 JSON fallback）
- 一个已登录 QQ 的 OneBot v11 网关（NapCat / SnowLuma / Lagrange.OneBot / LLOneBot），或者用仓库里的
  `scripts/mock-gateway.mjs` 做本地自测

## 安装

插件包目录：`packages/dsh-onebot-qq`（`package.json` 里同时声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch` 与 `dsh.client`，
安装后宿主半边和网页半边都会自动加载）。

### 方式 A：`dsh plugin` 命令行（推荐）

```powershell
# 安装到某个 profile（profile 名按你自己的，例如 web）
dsh plugin --profile web add C:\path\to\dsh-bot\packages\dsh-onebot-qq

# 启动该 profile（profile 是位置参数）
dsh web
```

### 方式 B：在 DSH 里用插件管理器

在 DSH Web 的插件管理（`plugin_manager` / 插件页）中安装本地目录
`packages/dsh-onebot-qq`，然后重启对应 profile 的 DSH 进程。安装完成后侧栏出现「QQ 连接」。

> 开发/临时验证：`scripts/verify-plugin.ps1` 会自动建一个一次性 profile（默认 `onebot-qq-verify`，
> 端口 3199），安装本插件、无头启动、探活 REST 与网页 boot 图，结束后清理 profile 与进程。
> 详见 [docs/USER-MANUAL.md](docs/USER-MANUAL.md#本地自测没有-qq-网关也能跑通)。

## 快速开始

1. 启动你的 QQ 网关，开启「正向 WebSocket」（NapCat 默认 `ws://127.0.0.1:3001`）与可选的
   「HTTP 服务端」（NapCat 默认 `http://127.0.0.1:3000`），并设置 access token。
2. 打开 DSH Web → 侧栏「QQ 连接」→「连接」标签。
3. 网关类型选「连接已有 OneBot v11 地址」；填 `ws://…`、可选的 `http://…` 和对应 token
   （WS / HTTP 可各有一个 token）。
4. 填机器人 QQ 号（用于账号核验）；账号不一致策略先用默认「只警告」。
5. 「保存并连接」→ 概览页应显示「已连接」与正确的登录昵称；「消息」页可发私聊/群聊；
   「日志」页能看到连接与核验过程。
6. 也可以用「SnowLuma 地址读取」模式：选网关类型 `snowluma`、填 SnowLuma 安装目录（含 `index.mjs`
   与 `config/`），插件只读配置取端口与 token，不启动、不注入 SnowLuma。

逐步图文说明见 [docs/USER-MANUAL.md](docs/USER-MANUAL.md)；全部配置项见 [docs/CONFIG.md](docs/CONFIG.md)。

## 数据与状态

- 数据目录：`$DSH_HOME/plugins-data/dsh-onebot-qq/`（`$DSH_HOME` 默认 `~/.dsh`），可用环境变量
  `DSH_ONEBOT_QQ_DATA_DIR` 覆盖（测试/便携部署用）。
- 文件：`config.json`（配置）；可选 `events.jsonl`（`events.persist.enabled`）；可选 `logs/`（`logging.persist.enabled`）。
- 保存配置即热应用：端点/账号类改动会自动重连，过滤/超时类改动即时生效；写盘是原子写。
- token 以 `secret` 类型存储，日志与状态快照里统一脱敏；状态快照只暴露脱敏后的地址。

## REST 接口（前缀 `/onebot-qq/api`）

所有响应为 JSON。成功 `{ ok: true, … }`；失败 `{ ok: false, message }`（HTTP 仍为 200，面板统一处理）。
除 `/health`、`/status` 等只读接口外，写操作均为 POST。

| Method | Path | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/health` | 轻量探活：`{ ok, version, apiVersion, state, uptimeMs }` |
| GET | `/status` | 状态快照（`gateway.state` / `loginCheck` / `login` / 统计）+ 事件/日志统计 + 最近事件 |
| GET | `/config` | `{ config, defaults, groups, dataDir, version }`；`groups` 是面板字段表（数据驱动） |
| POST | `/config/save` | body `{ config }` 全量保存，返回规范化后的 config 与 `issues`（非法值回退提示） |
| POST | `/config/reset` | 恢复默认值并写盘 |
| POST | `/connect` | 连接（含账号核验） |
| POST | `/disconnect` | 断开并停止自动重连 |
| POST | `/reconnect` | 断开后重新连接 |
| POST | `/probe` | body 可选覆盖端点，只走 HTTP 调一次 `get_login_info`，不改连接状态 |
| GET | `/gateway/detect` | SnowLuma 探测 + 当前端点解析结果（只读，不含明文 token） |
| GET | `/login-info` | 实时 `get_login_info` |
| GET | `/friends` / `/groups` | 好友列表 / 群列表 |
| POST | `/send` | `{ chatType: 'private'\|'group', chatId, message }`（字符串或消息段数组） |
| POST | `/action` | `{ action, params }` 原始透传；需开启 `security.allowRawAction` |
| GET | `/events?since=&limit=` | 事件环形缓冲（增量拉取，返回 `{ items, nextSince }`） |
| POST | `/events/clear` | 清空事件缓冲 |
| GET | `/logs?since=&limit=&level=` | 日志环形缓冲（增量 + 等级过滤） |
| POST | `/logs/clear` | 清空日志 |

**DSH 事件总线**（供其它插件消费）：

| 事件 | 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `onebot-qq/event` | `(record)` | 一条已规范化并接受的事件（与 `/events` 的 item 同形） |
| `onebot-qq/state` | `(snapshot)` | 连接状态变化时的状态快照（与 `/status` 的 `gateway` 同形） |
| `onebot-qq/config` | `(config, previous)` | 配置保存/重置后的热应用通知 |

# dsh-bot · DSH QQ 接入插件（OneBot v11）

本仓库当前交付 **`dsh-onebot-qq`**：为 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
提供一个 **QQ 接入插件**。它通过 **OneBot v11** 协议连接 **NapCat / SnowLuma / Lagrange.OneBot /
LLOneBot** 等 QQ 网关的正向 WebSocket + HTTP 地址，把 QQ 变成 DSH 可感知、可操作的外部通道，
并提供**完整的网页面板与持久化配置**。

> 这是更大目标（`goal-context.md`：具有长期记忆、人物画像、情绪/人格、技能演化的人工认知架构）。
> v0.4 起本包同时提供**平台感知/执行接入层**与**内置认知内核**；v0.5 增加**统一模型协议网关**；v0.6 增加**人格工作台、群聊参与与运行诊断**；v0.7 增加**多人格库与人格切换**；v0.8 增加**人格级认知数据隔离与数据复制**；v0.9 修复**DSH 一次性模型调用（system/sessionId/temperature）**并增加**人格 JSON 导入、模型链路自检与蒸馏人格实测**（OpenAI/Responses/Anthropic/Gemini/Ollama + OpenCode Go/Command Code/OpenRouter）。
> 连接、核验、事件规范化、消息收发保持稳定边界；人格、人物、关系、记忆、情绪、策略、学习、技能与元认知在
> `packages/dsh-onebot-qq/src/cognition/` 中实现，通过 SQLite + 算法/服务持久化，而不是把所有东西塞进一个巨大 Prompt。

## 能力

- **连接管理**：OneBot v11 正向 WS 收事件 + HTTP 调接口；自动重连（退避/抖动/超时/重试全部可配）；
  只配 HTTP 时明确提示「无法实时收事件」；连上后按 `get_login_info` 核验登录账号
  （`off` / `warn` / `enforce` 三种策略），核验期间事件先缓冲、通过后按序补发，不丢消息。
- **事件规范化**：消息 / 通知 / 请求 / 元事件 → 统一结构（消息段、@、图片、引用、发送者、群/私聊），
  「平台没给就不伪造」；过滤规则（忽略用户/群、事件类型、消息子类型、是否含机器人自己）全部走配置；
  事件可选 JSONL 落盘；同时通过 `ctx.emit('onebot-qq/event', record)` 暴露给其它 DSH 插件。
- **动作**：发私聊/群聊（字符串自动转文本消息段、支持消息段数组）、好友/群/群成员、撤回、查询消息、
  原始 action 透传（默认关闭，需显式开启）。
- **SnowLuma 只读适配**：自动探测安装目录、读取它自己的 `config/onebot*.json`（含 `onebot_<uin>.json`、
  `mode: snapshot`）得到地址与 token；**不下载、不启动、不注入**（尊重其 EULA）。读不到时回退手填地址并说明原因。
- **完整面板**：DSH Web 侧栏「QQ 连接」入口 + 整页面板，十个标签：概览 / 连接 / 消息 / 配置 / 人格 / 模型 / 系统设置 / 认知 / 日志 / 关于。
  视觉与动效按 `console-web` 的设计体系（令牌 + 语义动效配方）重做：eyebrow 页头、软底 + surface 卡片、
  软阴影/大圆角、soft Tabs + 滑块、StatTile/MiniBars、骨架屏、presence 反馈、trickle 进度、状态脉冲与数字滚动。
  新增的「系统设置」参考 console-web preferences：DSH 全局主题（浅色/深色/跟随系统）、强调色、对比度、
  密度、字号、内容宽度、动效模式与页面切换动画；分类切换只替换右侧内容、不整页滑动，修改即时保存。
  「认知」标签提供状态/人物/关系/记忆/情绪/策略/学习/技能/元认知/设置 11 个子页，
  可暂停/演练、查看决策与未知、删除/导出人物数据，全部走服务层命令。
  「人格」顶层工作台用自然语言编辑名字、身份、背景、性格、说话风格、喜好/边界和示例，
  可预览注入 prompt 并决定群聊参与方式（仅@/概率/所有消息）；支持保存多份人格并随时切换，
  记忆/人物/关系/情绪/策略/技能等认知数据也按人格隔离，并可把指定数据组复制给另一人格。
  「模型」标签提供统一协议网关：OpenAI Chat/Responses、Anthropic、Gemini、Ollama，
  以及 OpenCode Go、Command Code、OpenRouter 预设；可配 base URL/认证/headers/模型，
  支持流式、模型发现、连通测试、直连/DSH 路由与 fallback；密钥只在本地，API 只回传后四位。
  配置页 100% 由服务端字段表驱动（新增配置项不需要改 UI），支持保存/撤销/恢复默认/Ctrl+S、
  dirty 提示、toast、加载/空态/错误重试；`reduced`/`off` 与系统 `prefers-reduced-motion` 双重降级，
  浅/深色（`body[data-ds-dark-theme]`）与 190–390px 窄宽均已验证。
- **不写死参数**：所有可调算法参数集中在 `src/core/config.js` 的 `DEFAULTS`，首次运行写出
  `$DSH_HOME/plugins-data/dsh-onebot-qq/config.json`，面板可改，热应用（连接相关改动自动重连）。

## 安装

```powershell
$dsh = "C:\Users\Run\AppData\Local\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd"

# 1) 链接进某个 profile（推荐先用临时 profile 验证；desktop 是当前 GUI 的 profile）
& $dsh plugin --profile desktop add "C:\rin\coder\rin721\dsh-bot\packages\dsh-onebot-qq"

# 2) 重启 / 刷新 DSH 后，侧栏出现「QQ 连接」
```

也可以在 DSH 的插件管理里以本地 bundle 安装 `packages/dsh-onebot-qq`。详细步骤、NapCat / SnowLuma
开网关方式、面板用法与 FAQ 见 [`packages/dsh-onebot-qq/docs/USER-MANUAL.md`](packages/dsh-onebot-qq/docs/USER-MANUAL.md)。

## 快速开始

1. 在 QQ 网关（NapCat / SnowLuma 等）里开启「正向 WebSocket 服务端」（常见默认端口 `3001`）和
   「HTTP 服务端」（常见默认端口 `3000`），设置 access token；
2. DSH 侧栏打开「QQ 连接」→「连接」页填 `ws://127.0.0.1:3001`、`http://127.0.0.1:3000` 与 token，
   填机器人 QQ 号（用于核验）→ 保存 → 连接；
3. 「概览」看到 `已连接` 与 `核验通过` 即接入成功；「消息」页可直接发私聊/群消息并查看事件流。

> 只想本机自测、没有真实网关？运行 `scripts/mock-gateway.mjs` 起一个假网关（默认 `6700`），
> 填它的地址/token 即可走通全部面板与接口。

## 仓库结构

```
dsh-bot/
├── goal-context.md                     # 项目总纲（人工认知架构愿景与原则）
├── docs/ARCHITECTURE.md                # 本插件与团队协作的接口契约
└── packages/dsh-onebot-qq/             # 插件包（DSH bundle + client plugin）
    ├── package.json                    # dsh.bundle.patch / dsh.client 清单
    ├── cordis.patch.yml                # bundle 插入行
    ├── client.js                       # 网页半边：侧栏入口 + 十标签整页面板（配置/人格/模型/系统设置/认知持久壳）
    ├── src/host.js                     # 宿主半边入口（组装 gateway/events/models/routes）
    ├── src/core/                       # 配置、持久化、日志、脱敏、事件缓冲
    ├── src/gateway/                    # 连接生命周期、事件规范化、action、SnowLuma 只读适配
    ├── src/onebot/client.js            # OneBot v11 WS/HTTP 客户端（重连/echo/握手超时）
    ├── src/http/routes.js              # /onebot-qq/api/* REST（含 /cognition/*、/models/*）
    ├── src/cognition/                  # 认知内核：turn/store/persona/emotion/person/relationships/memory/policy/learning/skills/meta/proactivity
    ├── src/model/                      # 模型协议网关：OpenAI/Responses/Anthropic/Gemini/Ollama/中转预设
    ├── test/                           # 146 个 node:test（含多人格/认知/模型协议/live 环境门控/e2e/UI）
    ├── scripts/                        # 真实 DSH 验证 / 模型连通验证 / 独立 mock 网关
    └── docs/                           # 用户手册、配置手册、模型协议、验证报告、截图
```

## 验证

- `node --test packages/dsh-onebot-qq/test/*.test.js` → **146 个用例**（无 key 142 通过 + 4 live skip；有 OpenCode key 时 146/146）；
- `packages/dsh-onebot-qq/scripts/verify-plugin.ps1` → 临时 profile 真实 DSH 安装/启动/REST/boot 图/认知 SQLite/模型 API
  **RESULT: PASS**（可重复运行，自动清理）；
- `packages/dsh-onebot-qq/scripts/verify-model-gateway.mjs` → 真实 OpenCode Go OpenAI/Anthropic/模型发现，
  OpenRouter/Command Code 公开模型发现；key 只从 env 读取。
- 真实 DSH + mock 网关 + Chrome headless：面板实际渲染、连接态核验、事件/发送/断开全链路 **16/16**；
  认知真实数据流：人物/关系/记忆/决策产生、演练不发送、10 标签与 11 子页、360px 无横向溢出；
  模型真实链路：OpenCode Go 直连分析+回复、10 标签、模型页无溢出；
  另有 UI/动效/系统设置专项断言（`getAnimations()`：标签切换 180ms、reveal stagger、持久壳只换右内容、
  DSH 主题切换、即时保存、对比度、reduced/off、暗色根背景、360px 无横向溢出）**48/48** 全部通过，
  截图与证据见 [`packages/dsh-onebot-qq/docs/verification/`](packages/dsh-onebot-qq/docs/verification/)。
  实际能力边界与未实现项见
  [`IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md`](packages/dsh-onebot-qq/docs/cognitive/IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md)。
- 完整证据、根因复盘（含一个 Cordis `Config` 槽位冲突导致的激活失败修复）与限制见
  [`docs/VERIFICATION.md`](packages/dsh-onebot-qq/docs/VERIFICATION.md)。

## 复用与许可

本插件**不重复造轮子**：OneBot 客户端、存储/脱敏/日志、SnowLuma 只读解析、mock 网关、fake DSH、
面板注册结构与 DSH 主题 token 用法复用/改写自成熟的 DSH 插件
[`aureth-labs/dsh-aurabot-qq`](https://github.com/aureth-labs/dsh-aurabot-qq)（MIT）与
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（MIT）；本版面板的视觉令牌与语义动效
参考用户自己的 `console-web` 前端基座（design-system tokens/motion foundation、surface 页面配方），
在单文件插件里重新实现，不复制其源码、不引入其运行时依赖。
运行时不引入任何第三方依赖（Node 内置 `fetch` / `WebSocket` + DSH 注入的 React）。
版权与许可证全文见 [`packages/dsh-onebot-qq/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](packages/dsh-onebot-qq/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)；
本仓库以 MIT 许可发布（`packages/dsh-onebot-qq/LICENSE`）。

## 后续方向（不属于本插件）

接入层之上将按 `goal-context.md` 继续构建：消息防抖与会话轮次、人物画像与持久化关系、记忆
（情景/语义/程序性）、情绪与人格状态、注意力与工作记忆、行为规划与反馈学习、技能习得与演化，
以及供这些模块使用的可观测性与调试面板。本插件已经把这些能力需要的输入（规范化事件流、
连接状态、消息发送动作）以稳定的接口与 DSH 事件形式提供出来。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
deepseek-bot

The agentic memory & gateway for DeepSeek Harness.
One always-on agent that remembers across conversations,
and answers in Slack, Discord, Telegram and the terminal.

> **Sponsors** > These are our sponsors. They help keep deepseek-bot going as a personal side project. > | [](https://opengateway.ai/) | **[OpenGateway](https://opengateway.ai/)** sponsors deepseek-bot. An OpenAI-compatible gateway that puts many model providers behind one API. Thank you for backing open source. | > | :-----| :----- | DeepSeek Harness runs an agent for one session at a time. deepseek-bot is a plugin for it that adds the two things a long-running agent needs: - **Memory.** Every conversation is a durable session that survives restarts. A persona, notes the agent keeps for itself, and a recall index over past conversations are brought into each turn, so it can say what was decided last week, with the date, or say plainly that it does not know. - **A gateway.** One agent, reachable where people already talk: Slack, Discord, Telegram, and a fullscreen terminal (`dsh`). It runs as a supervised macOS service, its commands run in a sandbox, and anything destructive waits for a yes in the conversation. ## Install ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rlaope/deepseek-bot/master/install.sh | bash dsh # talk to it in the terminal dsh gateway setup # connect Slack, Telegram or Discord: ↑↓ and Enter ``` The first line installs it, and running it again updates. It needs macOS with Node.js 22+, the DeepSeek Harness app and a DeepSeek API key — none asked for if the harness already has one. When the app is missing, the installer offers to download it from DeepSeek's own server (a few hundred MB, into `/Applications`), checked against the build's published hash. DeepSeek's own API is the default and needs nothing else; OpenGateway or another OpenAI-compatible endpoint is an option the installer offers. The bot starts with the terminal, `dsh`. `dsh gateway setup` connects a messenger: pick one with ↑↓ and Enter, and it opens the page where each token is made, checks each token as you paste it, and offers to restart the bot. `dsh gateway status` says whether it is up. `dsh update` updates.
From an agent, or a script Without a terminal the installer asks nothing: the language comes from `LANG`, the model route is DeepSeek's own, a key is used where the harness already has it (its app, `~/.dsh/.env`), and the DeepSeek Harness app is downloaded only when told to: ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rlaope/deepseek-bot/master/install.sh | DEEPBOT_INSTALL_HARNESS=1 bash ``` `dsh gateway setup ` then reads the platform's tokens from the environment. Where to put the key first, and what each stop means: [installing without a terminal](docs/setup.md#installing-without-a-terminal).
**Optional: faster on [OpenGateway](https://opengateway.ai).** It serves `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-ultrafast` on an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (`https://apis.opengateway.ai/v1`), which it lists at 12× the speed and 1/30 the price of a Fable-class model. This bot is developed against it; the model route in [profile/cordis.patch.yml](profile/cordis.patch.yml) shows where the endpoint and the model go.

## Memory Four layers, each with one owner. The agent reads all of them; it can write only the ones in its home. | Layer | What it holds | Where | Written by | |---|---|---|---| | Working | this conversation | the harness's session log, one per thread or chat | the harness | | Identity | who the agent is, how it speaks, its rules | `SOUL.md`, `AGENTS.md` in the agent home | you | | Semantic | durable facts about you and the work, dated | `USER.md`, `MEMORY.md`, `memory/*.md` | the agent (you may edit) | | Episodic | what was said in earlier conversations | a recall index under `~/.dsh/recall/`, outside the agent home | a host-side indexer | - **Recall is scoped to the channel.** Passages come only from the conversation's own channel, so a private conversation never surfaces in a public one. The agent cannot search the index itself; the adapter injects passages before the turn, marked as content, not instructions. - **Recall matches words, and the model picks among the latest.** Passages are ranked by the rare words they share with the message; for a message that points at the past, the conversation's model also chooses among the channel's latest 40 passages, which finds a past said in other words. There is no vector index: an older passage put in other words can still be missed. - **Not found is an answer.** Asked about something never said, it says so rather than guessing. - **The persona is plain Markdown.** Edit `SOUL.md` and it changes. `npm run persona` checks the files against their budgets, and flags duplicated facts, undated lines and secrets. How each layer reaches the prompt, and why: [docs/how-it-works.md](docs/how-it-works.md#memory-the-layers-and-who-writes-what). ## Gateway | Platform | How | State | |---|---|---| | Slack | Socket Mode; threads, streaming, approval buttons, uploads | used live | | Terminal (`dsh`) | a local socket; streamed answers, tool calls with their diffs, approvals and questions in place | used live | | Discord | gateway websocket and REST; buttons, uploads | tested against a mocked API, not a live server | | Telegram | long polling; buttons, uploads, Markdown | tested against a mocked API, not a live bot | One messenger at a time beside the terminal: every conversation the terminal does not claim goes to the first messenger listed, so a second would never be answered, and `dsh gateway setup` replaces rather than adds. While a turn runs, the platform's own indicator shows: Slack's working status under the thread, "typing…" on Discord and Telegram. **Talking to it.** Mention it in a channel or message it directly; it answers in the thread. A follow-up sent while it works waits its turn. `stop` ends the running turn, `usage` shows the thread's token totals, and `allow` or `deny` (or the buttons) answers a request for approval. The words are understood in English, Korean and Chinese; the bot's own notices follow the `language` setting (`en` by default, `ko`, `zh`). **What it can do in a turn.** Write a docx, xlsx or pptx and upload it into the conversation; read a link, with a headless browser for a page that draws itself; look at an image, with a model that accepts one; use the tools of an MCP server you add (`dsh gateway mcp add`); run a command in the background and post what it found when it finishes. It speaks first only when asked to: "tell me when this changes" becomes a watch, "remind me on Friday" a reminder. **Containment.** Its commands run under a Seatbelt sandbox that writes only its own workspace and cannot read the deployment's tokens, other agents' files, the stored conversations or your credential files. A command that deletes or overwrites waits for the person who asked. Text in a thread or an attachment that tries to give it orders is flagged before the model sees it. On Telegram and Discord anyone who finds the bot can message it: list who may with `dsh gateway setup telegram --users `. **Staying up.** It runs as launchd jobs: it reconnects on its own, a probe restarts it when it is not connected and can alert you when it does not recover, and a conversation is told when a restart cut its turn short. ## How well it works Three kinds of evidence, not equivalent: | Evidence | What it covers | Where it runs | |---|---|---| | Unit suites (`pnpm test`) | the adapter, every transport, the sandbox runner, the installer and `dsh gateway`, against fakes | CI, on every change | | Scenarios (`test/scenarios/*.json`) | recall across conversations, approvals, read isolation, tenants, injection, the browser, MCP, background jobs — against a real model, in a throwaway home | by hand, or daily once `service/install-scenarios.sh` schedules them; not in CI | | Live use | Slack and the terminal | the developer's own deployment | What is not verified is listed, item by item, in [PLAN.md](PLAN.md#unverified). The short version: - macOS only. On Windows it builds, its suites pass and the terminal can be run by hand, but the installer, services, sandbox and watches are not ported, so every command is refused ([Windows, by hand](docs/setup.md#windows-by-hand-the-terminal-only)). - Discord and Telegram have not had a live round trip. - The sandbox is a policy boundary, not a separate OS user. An MCP server runs outside it, with the gateway's rights: add only servers you trust. - DeepSeek Harness is a release candidate, and this project leans on its internals (session driving, message construction). Pin your version. ## Built small TypeScript. The plugin imports nothing from `node_modules`; the one runtime dependency, `playwright-core` (pinned), is loaded only by the browse tool. Recall needs no vector store and no database: the index is a JSONL file. ## More - [Setup and operations](docs/setup.md): connecting a messenger, creating the bot on each platform, the model provider, MCP servers, the agent's network, running the services - [How it works](docs/how-it-works.md): the design, and the evidence behind each claim - [Limitations](docs/limitations.md) · [Specification](SPEC.md) · [Plan](PLAN.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) - For contributors and agents: [working rules](AGENTS.md) · [vocabulary](CONTEXT.md) ## License [MIT](LICENSE). deepseek-bot is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. The whale and the wordmark are the DeepSeek logo's; the DeepSeek name and logo belong to their owner.

# dsh-archived-sessions

> 查看、**恢复**和删除 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）中已归档的会话：在设置页找回归档列表、阅读完整对话（轮次 / 推理 / 工具执行 / Markdown 表格），一键把归档会话**恢复回侧边栏活跃列表**。桌面端与 Web 端通用。

DSH 中「归档会话」后，会话会从所有界面消失且没有官方入口找回。这个插件在设置面板新增「**已归档会话**」页面，把归档列表找回来，并支持**取消归档（恢复）**。

## 截图

<!-- 把截图放到 docs/screenshots/ 后，在下方按 `![说明](docs/screenshots/文件名.png)` 填入 -->
![已归档会话列表](docs/screenshots/archived-list.png)
![会话详情弹窗（含恢复按钮）](docs/screenshots/archived-viewer.png)

## 功能

- **归档列表**：标题、所属工作区、消息数、最后活跃时间一目了然；支持刷新；**v0.3.0 起**每页 10 条分页，并支持按**标题 / 工作区**即时搜索过滤。
- **对话查看器**：点击会话弹出只读对话流（弹窗覆盖在设置面板之上，关闭后回到列表）。
  - 按**轮次**分组，每轮把「工作过程」（推理、工具调用、命令执行）折叠起来，最终回答清晰呈现；
  - Markdown 渲染：标题、无序/有序列表、引用、链接、代码块（自动美化 JSON）、**表格**（可横向滚动）；
  - 工具执行以终端卡片展示：工具名、状态点（成功/失败）、`$` 命令行、可展开的输出；
  - 系统注入的消息（运行上下文快照、技能清单等）单独折叠，不会和用户消息混淆。
- **恢复归档会话**（v0.2.0+）：两步确认，把归档会话**取消归档**，回到侧边栏活跃列表的原位置。
  - 入口有两个：归档列表每个会话行右侧的「恢复」按钮；**v0.2.3 起**会话详情弹窗页脚也有「恢复」按钮。
  - DSH 只有 `archiveSession` 没有取消归档 API，本插件通过 workspace 注册表自己的存储域（`storageDomain.get('workspace').global`）把会话 id 从 `archivedSessionIds` 移除——与产品归档共用同一条持久化写入链，改动实时生效、重启后保持，并会清除该会话在本插件中的墓碑记录。
- **删除归档记录**：两步确认，从归档列表移除。DSH 产品本身没有会话删除 API，因此实现为「墓碑」——会话保持归档状态（产品 UI 永远隐藏它），数据文件保留在磁盘（与产品行为一致）。

## 安装

`dsh plugin` 必须指定 `--profile`（对应你要装到的运行环境）：

```bash
# 本 fork：把 vX.Y.Z 换成 dsh-config-pack 锁上的 tag
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Robert-Wang-08/dsh-archived-sessions#vX.Y.Z
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Robert-Wang-08/dsh-archived-sessions#vX.Y.Z
```

（`desktop` 是 DSH Desktop 应用使用的 profile 名，`web` 对应 `dsh web`；用了自定义 profile 就换成自己的名字。）安装后重启 DSH，在 **设置 → 已归档会话** 查看。

> 本 fork 不向 npm 发布。`@jiangdaoli/dsh-archived-sessions` 的 scope 属于上游。`dsh-config-pack` 用上面的 `github:...#vX.Y.Z` 安装；`package.json` 的 `prepare` 会在安装时执行 `pnpm build`，生成 `lib/`。标签或手动触发的 CI 只做安装和构建。

## 工作原理

- **Host 半部**（`src/index.ts` → `runtime.ts`）：通过官方 DSH 服务读取数据 —— `workspaceRegistry`（归档集合）、`sessionQuery`（标题 / 对话投影）、`sessionPersistence.readRaw`（损坏日志的宽松兜底）。经 Typert Remote 暴露 `archived/list`、`archived/surface`、`archived/delete`、`archived/restore`。
  - 删除只写入插件自己的 settings 命名空间（墓碑）；
  - 恢复通过 `storageDomain` 写入 workspace 域（从 `archivedSessionIds` 移除），从不改动会话数据本身。
- **Client 半部**（`src/client/index.ts`）：挂载 Remote 命名空间，注册 `settings.section`（id `archived-sessions`）。查看器在设置面板内部渲染，天然处于最顶层。
- **兼容性**：只使用官方 DSH contract，不注入任何 desktop 专属 service，桌面端 / Web / CLI 均可用。

## 开发

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build   # esbuild 单文件 host + client 产物到 lib/
pnpm typecheck
```

发布流程（含本地验收门、CHANGELOG 与 Release 说明步骤）见 [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md)。

## 说明与限制

- 删除仅移除归档记录；会话数据保留在磁盘（DSH 从不删除会话数据）。
- 日志损坏（seq 缺口）的会话会显示「日志损坏」标记，打开时展示可解析的部分内容。
- 恢复（取消归档）写 workspace 存储域的 `archivedSessionIds`——这是该数据的唯一持久位置，与产品归档动作共用写入链；会话数据本身不被触碰。
- **继续对话**：恢复后会话回到侧边栏活跃列表，点开即可继续对话（原会话、原日志，直接接着聊）。

## 更新日志

各版本变更见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)；GitHub Releases 同步发布说明。

## 宿主兼容性（2026-09-23 复查：dsh 0.1.5-rc.3 + dsh-permission-compat）

宿主升级 `0.1.5-rc.2 → rc.3`（npm latest）并打上全局 `dsh-permission-compat` 沙箱补丁（改 `dsh-sandbox` + 三个工具守卫）后复查，**本插件零改动可用**：

- 与补丁无关：源码与 `lib/` 构建产物不引用 `sandbox_permissions` / `justification` / `approveEscalation` 等提权 API（grep 零命中）。
- 与 rc.3 无关：服务端唯一外部依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol`，连同 `dsh-settings`、`dsh-api-settings-controller`，rc.2↔rc.3 发布包逐字节相同（仅 package.json 版本号）；本 fork 的 dsh-settings 0.1.5 API fix 覆盖 rc.2/rc.3 同代 API。
- 客户端 bundle 仍是对 `0.1.0-rc.7` client-runtime 构建——既有状态，非本次引入，rc.3 下无变化。

复查记录见 vault `70-WorkSpace/dsh工具维护日志.md` 2026-09-23 条目；复装说明见 `70-WorkSpace/dsh复装说明.md`。

## License

MIT

# @rrrrrredy/dsh-agent-memory

Community DeepSeek Harness Bundle for [Agent Memory System](https://github.com/rrrrrredy/agent-memory-system). It can preserve Harness sessions as a crash-safe local append-only event spool and can inject only verified, active, promoted memory before an agent step.

This is a community plugin, not an official DeepSeek plugin.

## Compatibility

- DeepSeek Harness / `@deepseek-ai/dsh`: `0.1.0-rc.6`
- Agent Memory CLI: `>=0.3.1 <1` for `deepseek-harness` import and injection support
- Node.js: `22.19.x` or `24+`

Capture and retrieval are independent, explicit opt-ins. The default Bundle row is inert until at least `captureDir` or both retrieval roots are configured.

## Install

Install the Agent Memory CLI when retrieval or import is required:

```bash
go install github.com/rrrrrredy/agent-memory-system/cmd/agentmem@v0.3.1
```

Install the public Bundle into the Harness profile you use:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile headless add @rrrrrredy/dsh-agent-memory@0.1.0
dsh --profile headless --dump-config
```

For the browser surface, replace `headless` with `web`. For a local release candidate, replace the npm specifier with the absolute path to the packed `.tgz`.

## Configure

Update the `agent-memory` row in that profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. All storage paths must be absolute.

```yaml
- id: agent-memory
  config:
    binary: agentmem
    captureDir: /absolute/local/path/outside-any-git-worktree/dsh-capture
    evidenceRoot: /absolute/local/path/agent-memory-evidence
    portableRepo: /absolute/path/to/portable-memory-repository
    scopeRepository: account/example
    scopeProject: example
    scopeTask: agent-work
    limit: 5
    tokenBudget: 600
    byteBudget: 3072
    timeoutMs: 3000
    stdoutMaxBytes: 131072
    stderrMaxBytes: 131072
    segmentMaxBytes: 33554432
```

- Set only `captureDir` for capture without retrieval.
- Set `evidenceRoot` and `portableRepo` together for retrieval without capture.
- Set all three paths to compose both capabilities.
- Trusted repository, project, and task scopes come only from this local configuration. Model text cannot select them.

On Windows, use fully qualified absolute paths and escape backslashes when the YAML parser requires it. The capture directory is rejected if it is inside a Git worktree, including through a linked path.

## Use

Run Harness normally:

```bash
dsh --profile headless "Continue this repository task using only relevant verified memory."
```

At the first accepted step of each turn, the Bundle sends only user-originated text to:

```bash
agentmem inject deepseek-harness --root <evidenceRoot> --repo <portableRepo> ...
```

A successful bounded response becomes a formal `user/message` whose source is `plugin: agent-memory` and form is `recall`, so it remains visible and replayable in the Harness event log. Missing CLI, timeout, output overflow, nonzero exit, damaged JSON, failed verification, or an empty result all continue without memory. The Bundle never falls back to stale, partial, unverified, or cached context.

Import the local capture spool into the Agent Memory evidence ledger explicitly:

```bash
agentmem import deepseek-harness-events \
  --root <local-evidence-directory> \
  --path <captureDir>
```

Live `session/event` records are retained exactly as delivered by Harness. On startup, a raw-artifact-capable persistence backend is also read through `listSnapshots` and `readRaw`; its full session artifact is preserved verbatim. Unknown events, unsupported raw artifacts, malformed artifact rows, recovery problems, and read failures remain explicit gaps rather than disappearing.

## Privacy and security boundary

- Capture files are local-only raw evidence and may contain prompts, model output, locally exposed reasoning, tool calls, tool results, paths, and secrets produced during the session.
- Raw Harness events, reasoning, tool output, and session artifacts must never be committed to Git, packed into npm, or attached to a GitHub Release.
- The Bundle adds no telemetry, hosted service, remote storage, or model tool. Harness still sends ordinary conversation content to the model provider configured for the profile.
- Retrieval returns only memory that Agent Memory validates as active and promoted from a complete portable repository. Capture does not automatically promote anything.
- `raw_exposed` means the text existed in the local Harness artifact. It does not claim access to provider-hidden reasoning.
- Local files are not an OS security boundary. A process with the same user privileges can alter local configuration or evidence.

## Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile headless remove @rrrrrredy/dsh-agent-memory
dsh --profile headless --dump-config
```

After removal, the Bundle row and package reference are absent, no event or pre-step listener remains, and later sessions do not add capture records or memory recall messages. Existing local capture and evidence files are deliberately retained; remove them separately only under your own retention policy.

## Reproduce the tests

From this directory:

```bash
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm verify
AGENTMEM_BINARY=/absolute/path/to/agentmem pnpm test:integration
pnpm pack --pack-destination .pack
```

`pnpm verify` covers config boundaries, canonical-source hashing, Git-worktree rejection, durable raw event capture, raw-artifact backfill and restart deduplication, explicit gaps, argv-only subprocess execution, timeouts, output bounds, malformed responses, trusted prompt selection, formal recall messages, real Cordis/SessionStore/JSONL Persistence composition, and clean disposal.

`pnpm test:integration` writes a real Bundle spool into an explicit scratch root, imports it with the compiled Agent Memory CLI, and requires a clean `agentmem doctor` result. Set `AGENT_MEMORY_DSH_TEST_TMP` to keep all scratch work on a chosen volume.

The [0.1.0 public release evidence](release-evidence/0.1.0.md) records the separate isolated-profile public install/remove test and real DeepSeek model smoke. Raw session and memory evidence are excluded from the package and release assets.

# Agent Memory System

[![CI](https://github.com/rrrrrredy/agent-memory-system/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/rrrrrredy/agent-memory-system/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

Local-first, evidence-backed memory for coding agents.

Agent Memory System preserves the task evidence a runtime exposes, rebuilds it
into episodes, turns supported observations into reviewable memory candidates,
and shares only redacted memories with explicit validation and promotion
records through a separate private Git repository. Deployment policy requires
an operator to make those decisions; the software binds each attestation to
the evidence but does not authenticate that the caller is human.

It is built for a harder question than “what should the agent remember?”:

> What evidence supports this memory, is it still current, and can another
> machine use it without receiving the private transcript?

Version **0.3.0** adds immutable memory loadouts, evidence-bound review packets,
replay-verifiable local Codex execution receipts, prospective longitudinal
study records, and a loopback-only read-only dashboard to the storage,
derivation, review, private Git, retrieval, recovery, and evaluation foundation.
Runtime adapters remain version-sensitive. The system fails closed when
evidence is incomplete or a compatibility claim cannot be verified.

## Why this is different

Most memory tools summarize a conversation and place the summary in a retrieval
index. This project separates evidence, judgment, and distribution:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A["Agent-local traces"] --> B["Append-only evidence ledger"]
    B --> C["Episodes and compaction checks"]
    C --> D["Candidate memories"]
    D --> E["Validation attestation"]
    E --> F["Promote, supersede, or revoke"]
    F --> G["Private Git memory repository"]
    G --> H["Bounded cross-agent retrieval"]
    H --> I["Immutable memory loadouts"]
    I --> J["Native receipts and prospective studies"]
```

Raw transcripts, tool output, exposed reasoning, and local paths remain in the
local evidence store. Git receives only the portable projection of an approved
memory. A private repository is not treated as permission to upload raw task
history.

## Core guarantees

- Exact source bytes are content-addressed before normalization.
- Every evidence record participates in an append-only SHA-256 chain.
- A cross-process writer lock prevents compliant writers from forking a store.
- Missing, truncated, opaque, or unavailable data becomes an explicit gap.
- Candidates cannot become portable memory without a validation attestation and
  a separate promotion attestation, each bound to the exact evidence state.
- Conflicting candidates are quarantined; cross-device semantic conflicts are
  reported instead of resolved with last-write-wins.
- Reviewer and approver identifiers are caller-supplied attestations. Operator
  policy requires a person to inspect the evidence, but the CLI does not
  authenticate a human identity.
- Active memories form immutable revision chains with explicit supersession and
  revocation.
- Retrieval verifies the complete portable repository, applies exact scope and
  result limits plus estimated-token and UTF-8 byte budgets, and records what
  was delivered.
- A memory loadout names exact active revision heads. Supersession or revocation
  makes the old loadout stale instead of silently substituting new content.
  Loadout-backed native execution holds the portable repository use lock from
  freshness verification through the terminal receipt.
- Review packets freeze the displayed candidate text, provenance, generation,
  and evidence prefix without combining validation and promotion authority.
- Native Codex receipts bind exact local executable bytes, request, JSONL,
  output, usage, and terminal state; they do not authenticate the remote
  provider, server-side model, or hidden reasoning.
- Prospective studies seal every request, acceptance assertion, and workspace
  snapshot before execution. A single-use study reservation is written before
  Codex starts; failures consume it, and outcomes replay the complete
  Agent-message bytes. Reports remain descriptive rather than causal.
- Externally executed three-condition studies can register a strictly validated,
  content-bound plan in the same append-only local evidence ledger. Registration
  preserves provenance only; it grants no execution or result authority.
- Raw evidence backup is optional, encrypted with age, and completely separate
  from the readable memory repository.
- `AGENTS.md`, Skills, and other rule surfaces are never changed without a
  distinct, target-bound approval.

These guarantees apply to locally available evidence. No client can recover
provider-hidden reasoning or bytes that the runtime never exposed.

## Install

The project can be built from source with Go 1.25 or newer.

Windows PowerShell:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/rrrrrredy/agent-memory-system.git
cd agent-memory-system
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .\bin | Out-Null
go build -o .\bin\agentmem.exe .\cmd\agentmem
.\bin\agentmem.exe version
```

macOS or Linux:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/rrrrrredy/agent-memory-system.git
cd agent-memory-system
mkdir -p ./bin
go build -o ./bin/agentmem ./cmd/agentmem
./bin/agentmem version
```

Tagged releases provide checksum-verified Windows, macOS, and Linux archives;
the supported installers target Windows and macOS. See [install, upgrade, and
uninstall](docs/install.md).

## Try the complete lifecycle

A privacy-safe fixture under `examples/quickstart` exercises the same path as
real Codex history. One command imports, derives, verifies, and reports the next
operator action:

```powershell
$Evidence = Join-Path ([System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ("agentmem-" + [guid]::NewGuid())
$Onboard = .\bin\agentmem.exe onboard codex --root $Evidence --path .\examples\quickstart | ConvertFrom-Json
.\bin\agentmem.exe status --root $Evidence
.\bin\agentmem.exe review list --root $Evidence --status review_ready --limit 20
```

```sh
evidence="$(mktemp -d)/evidence"
./bin/agentmem onboard codex --root "$evidence" --path ./examples/quickstart
./bin/agentmem status --root "$evidence"
./bin/agentmem review list --root "$evidence" --status review_ready --limit 20
```

Review and promotion remain separate explicit decisions; `onboard` never makes
either decision. The [quickstart](docs/quickstart.md) provides complete
PowerShell and POSIX commands for review, promotion, private Git export, exact
retrieval, and switching to an existing Codex sessions directory.

For everyday use, keep the same evidence directory and rerun `onboard codex`
when there is new history. Use `review list` to inspect pending memories and
`recall context` to supply relevant promoted memories to the next task:

```text
agentmem recall context --root <evidence> --repo <private-memory> --agent codex --query "the next task"
```

After upgrading extraction rules, run `onboard codex` once with `--rebuild`
to reprocess unchanged history in the existing store. See
[rebuild after an upgrade](docs/quickstart.md#rebuild-after-an-extraction-upgrade).

A runtime probe is optional and never gates history import:

```powershell
.\bin\agentmem.exe compatibility --agent codex
```

```sh
./bin/agentmem compatibility --agent codex
```

`history_import_available` remains separate from `runtime_status`, so a blocked
version probe does not hide a working offline importer.

## Compatibility and verification

| Surface | Current evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Codex rollout import | Maintainer-reported private real-rollout acceptance on Windows, plus public loss/compaction fixtures and cross-platform protocol tests; the private run is not independently reproducible from this repository |
| Claude Code import | Transcript, history, companion, thinking, and unknown-block fixtures on Windows, macOS, and Linux |
| OpenCode plugin | Pinned OpenCode runtime starts on a GitHub-hosted runner, loads the plugin, captures the matching `session.created` event, imports it, and verifies the ledger; no provider model or secret is used |
| DeepSeek Harness Bundle | Real Cordis, SessionStore, JSONL Persistence, and `agent/pre-step` composition tests cover verbatim backfill, crash-safe live capture, verified-memory injection, real CLI import, and clean unload; this is community-Bundle evidence, not DeepSeek certification |
| Review and memory lifecycle | Evidence-bound caller attestations, promotion, supersession, revocation, secret scanning, and conflict tests; caller identity is not authenticated |
| Cross-device memory | Private Git history verification, offline use, divergence handling, recovery, and hosted Windows/macOS/Linux tests |
| Native Codex memory diagnostic | A frozen 20-cluster synthetic suite ran 20 paired authenticated `codex exec` tasks with sealed no-tools policy and verified retrieval injections: 19 wins, 1 tie, 0 losses; baseline 1/20, memory 20/20; one-sided sign-test p=0.0000019073. This is bounded capability evidence, not longitudinal certification; see the [aggregate receipt](evals/results/codex-memory-capability-v1-2026-08-12.json) |
| Native Codex process receipts | Exact local Codex and runner bytes, request, arguments, raw JSONL, usage, output, and terminal state are replayed; provider, model, and private reasoning are not independently attested |
| Portable loadouts | Content-addressed exact revision sets, scope, Agent allowlist, budgets, stale-head rejection, and composite delivery receipts |
| Prospective studies | Pre-sealed requests and workspace snapshots, immutable Agent-message acceptance hashes, deterministic balanced assignment, one single-use study-bound attempt, and replay-derived outcomes; no completed real-world longitudinal efficacy claim is made |
| Learning efficacy | Frozen-corpus metrics and replay are implemented; efficacy certification remains blocked unless task execution is independently verified |

Run a local, non-mutating runtime probe:

```text
agentmem compatibility
```

The probe checks executable availability and version output. It does not claim
that an account is authenticated, that a provider ran a model, or that a native
session was captured. See [compatibility and evidence levels](docs/compatibility.md).

## Memory lifecycle

A portable memory is not an editable note. It is an immutable revision chain:

```text
promote -> active revision
active revision -> supersede -> new active revision
active revision -> revoke -> tombstone
```

Only the current, non-revoked head can be retrieved. Two roots, two children of
one parent, an altered historical file, or opposing active memories make
verification fail. See [promotion](docs/promotion.md) and
[portable memory](docs/portable-memory.md).

## Retrieval

Retrieval is deterministic and offline. It combines exact identity lookup,
Unicode word and CJK-bigram matching, scope specificity, evidence strength, and
stable tie-breaking. There is no zero-match fallback.

Use the CLI directly or expose the same verified search through a local stdio
MCP server:

```text
agentmem recall search --root <evidence> --repo <private-memory> --agent codex --query "release checks"
agentmem serve mcp --root <evidence> --repo <private-memory> --agent codex
```

Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and DeepSeek Harness consume the same portable
protocol. Their native hooks, plugins, or Bundles are optional; CLI and MCP
remain the stable boundary. The DeepSeek Harness community Bundle is documented
under [`integrations/deepseek-harness`](integrations/deepseek-harness).

## Operational memory

Create a reusable, exact set of promoted revisions:

```text
agentmem loadout create --repo <private-memory> --name "Release checks" \
  --scope-kind project --scope-value example-project --agent codex \
  --memory <memory-id>
agentmem loadout context --root <evidence> --repo <private-memory> \
  --loadout <loadout-id> --agent codex --scope-project example-project
```

Build one immutable review surface before promotion:

```text
agentmem review packet --root <evidence> --status review_ready --limit 20
agentmem promote candidate --root <evidence> --candidate <candidate-id> \
  --packet <review-packet-path-or-id> --approver local-user \
  --reason "Approved after reviewing the bound packet."
```

Run and replay a local Codex process from a versioned request:

```text
agentmem agent run codex --root <evidence> --file <request.json> \
  --codex <codex-executable>
agentmem agent verify --root <evidence>
```

The local dashboard exposes verification summaries only:

```text
agentmem serve dashboard --root <evidence> --repo <private-memory>
```

See [loadouts](docs/loadouts.md), [native execution](docs/native-execution.md),
[prospective study registration and longitudinal studies](docs/longitudinal-study.md), and the
[dashboard](docs/dashboard.md).

## Storage boundaries

| Zone | Contains | May enter Git? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Local evidence | Exact transcripts, tool output, exposed reasoning, normalized events, gaps, receipts | No |
| Portable memory | Attested and redacted Markdown/YAML revisions plus immutable loadouts | Separate private repository only |
| Encrypted backup | Complete local evidence snapshot | Optional backup backend, never the memory repository |

Do not copy the entire Codex home, Agent state databases, session directories,
or the local evidence root into the memory repository. SQLite may be used as a
rebuildable local index, never as Git-merged canonical data.

## What the project does not claim

- It does not capture private chain-of-thought hidden by a provider.
- It does not treat a summary as the missing original reasoning.
- It does not automatically promote model-written claims.
- It does not silently merge semantic conflicts.
- It does not prove that retrieval improves work merely because retrieval ran.
- It does not turn a descriptive longitudinal association into causal or
  independently provider-certified efficacy.
- It does not modify Agent rules or install hooks without explicit approval.

## Repository map

- `cmd/agentmem`: cross-platform CLI
- `adapters`: loss-aware Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and DeepSeek Harness importers
- `internal/ledger`: append-only evidence and content-addressed blobs
- `internal/episodes`, `internal/candidates`: reconstruction and extraction
- `internal/review`, `internal/promotion`: attested decisions and memory lifecycle
- `internal/portable`, `internal/gitsync`: portable projection and private Git
- `internal/loadout`, `internal/retrieval`, `internal/mcpserver`: exact loadouts,
  bounded query, and delivery receipts
- `internal/reviewpacket`: immutable candidate review surfaces
- `internal/agentbridge`: replay-verifiable local Codex process evidence
- `internal/study`: prospective assignment, observation, and descriptive reports
- `internal/dashboard`: loopback-only read-only operational summary
- `internal/codexbench`: sealed native Codex baseline/memory diagnostics
- `internal/evaluation`: frozen corpora, paired trials, metrics, and replay
- `internal/backup`, `internal/diagnostics`: encrypted recovery and integrity
- `schemas`: versioned public JSON contracts
- `docs/adr`: architectural decisions and threat boundaries

Detailed protocol documentation lives under [`docs`](docs). Start with the
[product contract](docs/product-contract.md), [threat model](docs/threat-model.md),
and [verification guide](docs/verification.md).

## Development

```text
go test ./...
go vet ./...
go build ./cmd/agentmem
```

The CI matrix runs on Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS. Stateful safety packages also
run with the Go race detector. The OpenCode runtime smoke test installs its
pinned runtime only inside the disposable hosted runner. The DeepSeek Harness
Bundle has its own Node 22.19+/24 build, Cordis composition, and package tests.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) before changing an adapter, schema, or
evidence boundary. Never attach real transcripts or raw evidence to an issue.

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# 考研每日一题 · DSH 插件

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 用的每日一题插件：左侧栏一个入口，每个启用科目每天一道题，答案先经过**独立视角校验**才发布，配倒计时、错题本、收藏和按题隔离的追问侧栏。

面向中国大陆硕士研究生招生考试（考研），默认科目含思想政治理论、英语一/二、数学一/二/三、408 计算机学科专业基础综合，也可自行添加其他科目。

## 功能

**每日出题**
- 每个启用科目每天一道固定题目，同一天反复进入、刷新、切换科目都返回同一道；跨自然日自动换题。
- 两道题目来源：**在线出题**（宿主默认模型生成）与**题库出题**（导入 Markdown / 文本型 PDF），可按科目选择，也可设为“自动（优先题库）”。
- 出题与校验是两个独立步骤：先出题，再由另一个视角**先自己解题再看答案**，检查题干条件、可解性、答案唯一性、解析严谨性和判分规则。校验不通过会带反馈重出一次，仍不通过就**不发布**并如实报错。

**答题**
- 选择题：选 → 提交 → 判定 → 公布标准答案与完整解析。
- 主观题：只提供「作答完毕」与「未能作答」；「作答完毕」不会自动算答对，答案区域下方再由你自己判定「作答正确 / 作答错误」，未判定时是「待判定」，不进错题本。
- 每次「看过标准答案」才算一次作答，打开题目不算；重复提交同一 `attemptId`、刷新页面都不会重复计数，主动重新作答才会 +1。
- 作答历史逐条保留（时间、结果、选择），并区分「历史上答错过」与「当前已掌握」。

**四类列表**（每个科目互相隔离）
今日题目 / 全部 / 收藏 / 错题本。四者共享同一题目 ID，收藏或答错后立即同步；删除科目或删除题库都不会删掉历史题目、作答、收藏与追问。

**答案详解固定版本**
首次生成并通过校验后即固定（版本 ID + 首次展示时间），之后无论刷新、切科目、从其他列表进入都复用同一版本，不会重新生成；只有点「修订答案详解」才会产出候选新版本，候选必须重新通过独立校验、再由你确认替换，旧版本进版本历史。

**追问侧栏**
线程按题目 ID 隔离，只喂当前题目的题干、选项、正式答案与该线程历史；生成失败会保留原文并可重试，清空只影响当前题目。

**考研日期**
区分报名年份与实际考试日期：2028 考研 = 2027 年 12 月初试。已公布的用官方日期（不带「约」）；未公布的以上一年同一考试的官方日期推后一年估算，并在三行倒计时里都标「约」；查不到依据就明确写「尚未核实」，不编日期。页面上的「核验日期」会联网只采信 `moe.gov.cn` / `chsi.com.cn` / `neea.edu.cn`。

**渲染**
题干、选项、答案、解析均支持 Markdown：标题、列表、引用、表格、代码块（保留缩进与换行）、图片、行内与独立 LaTeX 公式。公式字体为 **Latin Modern Math**（随包附带），变量使用真正的数学斜体码位，数字与 `\sin` 等函数名保持直立。无法渲染的内容会以原文 + 提示保留，不会静默丢弃。

## 安装

需要可用的 DeepSeek Harness，以及一个能用的默认模型（在线出题要用）。三种方式任选其一。

### 1. DSH Desktop（图形界面）

插件面板 → 添加 → 选择本仓库目录（克隆后的本地目录）。装好后**刷新一次页面**，左侧栏会出现「考研每日一题」的图标（在「插件」「日程」旁边）。

### 2. 命令行（CLI / TUI profile）

`dsh plugin` 会把参数原样转发给 pnpm，所以本机需要先有 pnpm（`corepack enable pnpm`，或 `npm i -g pnpm`）。

```bash
# 直接从 GitHub 装（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:Scienmicroit/Daily-Question

# 或者先克隆，再按本地目录装
git clone https://github.com/Scienmicroit/Daily-Question
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add ./Daily-Question

# 或者用 Release 里附带的 tgz
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add ./daily-question-1.0.0.tgz
```

装完这条命令会把包里 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明的那一行自动叠加进 profile（`package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里会出现 `daily-question`），下次启动该 profile 即生效。

> **注意**：DSH Desktop 内置的 `desktop` profile 由应用独占管理，命令行会拒绝（`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`），请走上面的图形界面方式。

### 3. 让 Agent 装

已经装好 DSH 的话，把仓库路径告诉 Agent，让它调用 `plugin_manager install_bundle <绝对路径>` 即可。

### 升级与卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Scienmicroit/Daily-Question   # 重新装一次即为升级
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove daily-question                    # 卸载
```

卸载不会删除学习数据（`~/.dsh/kaoyan-daily/data.json`）。

## 首次使用

1. 点左侧栏图标进入，先「科目管理」勾选要考的科目（例如数学一、408）。
2. 在右上角年份下拉里选择你参加的考研年份，倒计时与目标日期随之更新。
3. 「今日题目」会为该科目出今天的题；首次在线出题需要几十秒（生成 + 独立校验）。
4. 想用题库：科目管理里把该科目来源切成「题库出题」或「自动」，再到「题库管理」导入 `.md` / `.txt` / 文本型 PDF，先在预览里核对识别结果，再确认入库。

## 数据与隐私

- 学习数据保存在本机：`~/.dsh/kaoyan-daily/data.json`（可用环境变量 `DSH_KAOYAN_DATA_DIR` 改路径）。单文件 JSON，原子写 + 串行队列，写失败会把错误抛给界面而不是静默丢弃。
- 在线出题与追问只走宿主自己配置的模型服务，不额外接入第三方；联网核验考试日期只访问教育部 / 教育考试院 / 研招网域名。
- 导入的题库文件只在本机解析，不上传。

## 目录结构

```
index.js              宿主入口（注册接口、加载数据文件）
client.js             浏览器端：侧栏入口 + 主面板 + Markdown/LaTeX 渲染 + 追问侧栏
lib/service.js        业务逻辑（设置、出题、作答、收藏、错题本、修订、追问、题库）
lib/store.js          JSON 持久化（原子写、事务式更新）
lib/generate.js       在线出题 + 独立答案校验 + 答案修订
lib/tutor.js          追问回复（严格限定当前题目）
lib/bank.js           题库解析（题干 / 选项 / 答案 / 解析 / 知识点 / 难度）
lib/pdf.js            纯 JS 的 PDF 文本提取（文本型 PDF，含 ToUnicode CMap）
lib/exam-dates.js     考研日期口径、估算规则、倒计时、官方日期联网核验
lib/routes.js         同源 HTTP 接口 + 公式字体路由
lib/subjects.js       科目目录、题型、大纲提示
lib/llm-json.js       模型调用与 JSON 容错解析
assets/               Latin Modern Math 字体及其许可文件
test/                 离线单元/集成测试（不需要模型与网络）
```

## 开发与测试

```bash
node test/check.mjs          # 日期口径、倒计时、题库解析、存储（32 项）
node test/service-check.mjs  # 业务状态机：出题/作答/错题/收藏/秒重/题库删除（32 项）
node test/render-check.mjs   # Markdown + LaTeX 解析（28 项）
node test/pdf-check.mjs <某个文本型 PDF 的路径>   # PDF 提取与题库识别（可选）
```

这些测试不联网、不调用模型、不需要 DSH，直接在 Node 20+ 跑。

## 已知限制

- **PDF 只支持文本型**：纯 JS 实现，不 OCR；扫描件、图片型 PDF 与带权限加密的 PDF 会明确拒绝并提示改用 Markdown，不会伪装成导入成功。
- **公式渲染是自写的 LaTeX 子集**：覆盖分式、根式、上下标、求和/积分/极限、矩阵、分段函数、希腊字母等常见结构；生僻宏会以原文保留并高亮提示。
- **导入题库的答案一律标「待核验」**，系统不会自动核验；只有「修订」流程会做独立校验。
- 主观题不做自动判分（按考试要求由你自己判定）。
- 暂未实现按知识点/难度筛选、学习统计与连续天数、题目质量反馈。

## 字体许可

`assets/latinmodern-math.otf` 是 Latin Modern Math 1.959，版权归 B. Jackowski、P. Strzelczyk、P. Pianowski（代表 TeX Users Groups），按 **GUST Font License**（LPPL 的一个实例）发布，允许自由使用与再分发。许可原文见 `assets/LICENSE-latin-modern-math.txt`。

## License

本插件代码以 **MIT** 许可发布，见仓库根目录的 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

`assets/latinmodern-math.otf` 不适用 MIT：它按 GUST Font License（LPPL 的一个实例）发布，许可原文见 `assets/LICENSE-latin-modern-math.txt`。

decision.reason: Held for versioned DSH compatibility. MIT, documented Git source and checked-in native modules exist, but no versioned DSH compatibility declaration was found. README explicitly names the bundled font license and client renders question cards; that notice does not substitute for host compatibility evidence. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.
