# Universal Diagnostic Tutor for DeepSeek Harness > **From a Tutor Skill to a Learning Runtime.** Diagnosis-first AI learning runtime for DeepSeek Harness — map what you need, learn interactively, and move to the next best step. ![The learning runtime in DeepSeek Harness: the conversation in the middle, the diagnosis map and the lesson docked beside it](preview/dsh-ui-v0107-ab.png) The learning surface docked in the right sidebar, beside the conversation. The map, the lesson and the chat are on screen at once, so answering a check never means leaving the lesson. ## Status `v0.3.0` is the published release. The learning surface is now three screens: **Today → Course → Study**, with Review, Knowledge & evidence and Insights as secondary views. - **Today**: one next action, due review, deadline, today's plan and your courses. - **Course**: the accepted route, module/lesson list, one continue action; when no route is accepted, a three-step **Goal → Diagnosis → Course preview** flow. - **Study**: one stored lesson block at a time, with a single primary action. Quiz and flashcard answers still go through the runtime; nothing is graded or advanced automatically. The content/input/review loop remains: typeset math, formula/code/quiz/flashcard/ resource/comparison blocks, sources with citations, Today/ICS, spaced review with undo, and read-only Insights. Install it with `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-diagnostic-tutor@0.3.0` — no clone, no `pnpm install`, no build step. A checkout can be installed instead (see [Installing a checkout](#installing-a-checkout-instead-of-the-package)). It is still early. The [limitations](#known-limitations) are listed rather than left to be discovered: no PDF extraction, no RAG, no automatic external resource fetching, no analytics. Review scheduling is a local interval heuristic, not FSRS. Course routes are proposed by the teaching model, never generated by the runtime, and a route never marks knowledge as mastered. ## Two halves, one system The unusual thing about this project is that **the teaching and the runtime are separate programs**, and only one of them makes decisions. | | Owns | Where | | --- | --- | --- | | **[Universal Diagnostic Tutor](https://github.com/SenmuuuuW/universal-diagnostic-tutor-skill) skill**
= **the teaching brain** | What to teach next: diagnosis, teaching moves, pacing, when a check is passed, what the next step is | that repository (v2.1, MIT) | | **`dsh-diagnostic-tutor`**
= **the learning runtime** | Where it is kept: persistent learner state, the diagnosis map, structured lessons, the UI | here | That split is not a packaging detail. This repository contains **no teaching logic**: no rule that says "if blocked, explain the prerequisite", no rule that says "if wrong, give a simpler example". Those live in the skill. The runtime stores what the tutor decided, shows it, and never decides it. ## The loop ``` Goal → Diagnose → Map → Learn → Check → Decide → Next lesson │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ └ the tutor names │ │ │ │ │ the next node, with a reason │ │ │ │ └ the learner answers in the chat │ │ │ └ the tutor writes the lesson into the side panel │ │ └ nodes appear only as diagnosis reveals them │ └ the tutor asks what you actually know └ stated in your own words, in the chat ``` Read left to right, that is also the guarantee: **the runtime never advances on its own.** A decision is stored with the tutor's reason, shown to the learner, and waits to be pressed. ### The demo scenario The screenshots below come from one scenario, run against real DeepSeek Harness with the real skill: > **I want to learn machine learning. I know some Python, but my math is weak.** The tutor asks what the goal is *for* before it teaches anything, then grows a map one diagnosis at a time. Nothing in these images is a fixture or a mock — they are screenshots of the running app. `demo-1` is a cold start from an empty store; the rest are the same scenario resumed, because the clarify-then-diagnose phase costs several model turns and a cold start to a full lesson runs to roughly fifteen minutes. | | | | --- | --- | | ![First use: the panel asks one question](preview/demo-1-first-use.png) | **First use.** No goal yet. One question, and the sentence that answers it — no wizard, no empty dashboard. | | ![The diagnosis map](preview/demo-3-map.png) | **The diagnosis map.** Six nodes, each traceable to evidence, nested by depth. `blocked` and `checked` read at a glance; nothing is `confirmed` without a check behind it. | | ![A lesson with a check](preview/demo-4-lesson.png) | **A lesson.** Real headings and lists, a worked example set apart, a diagram in its own frame, and a check that hands the turn back to the learner. | | ![The docked surface with the progress line](preview/demo-5-next-step.png) | **The docked surface.** The same loop in the right sidebar, with the handoff progress line (`Lesson ready 7s`) so a slow model turn reads as *working* rather than *broken*. | --- ## Why this is not just another AI tutor Most "AI tutor" projects are a prompt wrapped around a chat box: the model teaches, and nothing about the learner survives the conversation. Three things are different here. **The teaching brain is a real, separate artifact.** Diagnosis, teaching moves, pacing and mastery judgement live in a written skill with its own protocols — not in a system prompt this repository invented. This plugin depends on it and refuses to duplicate it. **State is real, and it is the learner's.** A goal, a map of what you actually know, and a record of the evidence behind each status. Nothing is `confirmed` without a check to back it, nothing is scored, and it is all visible and exportable. **The runtime does not decide.** The tutor names the next step and says why; the runtime stores that and shows it; the learner presses Continue. There is no path by which progress advances on its own. Its state vocabulary is not invented here either: nodes carry the skill's own seven status terms, and checks carry its six readiness outcomes. ### Why a map does not contradict diagnosis-first The skill is explicit that a broad goal must **never** become a pre-expanded curriculum or a course outline. This plugin does not produce one. Nodes appear only as diagnosis reveals them, every node is `unconfirmed` until a check produces evidence, and the map is reversible — new evidence moves it. What you see is a *diagnosis map*, not a syllabus. --- ## Known limitations Stated plainly, because each one is a real edge a user can reach. **Math is rendered as MathML on the host.** The tutor writes LaTeX by convention — `\(...\)` inline, `\[...\]` display — and the host pre-renders it with KaTeX's MathML output before storing the block. The browser renders native MathML through a tag/attribute whitelist; no font or CSS is fetched. Invalid TeX inside a text block falls back to the old styled source; an invalid `formula` block is refused at write time. Browser MathML quality varies, and this build ships no KaTeX CSS/fonts. **Skill presence requires a live Agent.** The runtime checks the open conversation's Agent scope on each overview, including its workspace. Before an Agent exists, or while discovery is empty or incomplete, it reports `cannot tell` and the panel stays quiet. Polling picks up later registration and Agent changes. If lessons never appear, check the skill first. **Storage is one document.** Every record lives in `/storages/udt.json`. It is readable, copyable and easy to export, and it is also a single point of failure: a record that no longer matches its schema stops the plugin from loading. Nothing is deleted when that happens, the error names the table and the key, and removing the record by hand restores the rest — but **export before you edit it**. **The tutor does not always converge.** It can judge `more-practice` on the same node several turns running, each time writing a fresh check. That is its pacing rather than the runtime's, but it decides whether a node ever finishes and the loop moves on. ## Compatibility A DSH profile can resolve **more than one harness version at once** (the running host, the shared profile fallback, and each plugin's own store). Treat this matrix as load-bearing, not decoration. | This plugin | Verified against DSH | Node | | --- | --- | --- | | `0.3.0` | `0.2.1-rc.5`, `0.2.1-rc.3`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.0-rc.2` (test suite also on `0.1.7-alpha.2`) | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` | | `0.2.0` | `0.2.1-rc.5`, `0.2.1-rc.3`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.0-rc.2` (test suite also on `0.1.7-alpha.2`) | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` | | `0.1.1` | `0.2.1-rc.3`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.0-rc.2` (test suite also on `0.1.7-alpha.2`) | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` | | `0.1.0` | `0.1.7-alpha.2` (also composed under `0.1.5-rc.1`) | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` | **2026-10-30 追加 `0.2.1-rc.5`（当前桌面 runtime）验证**：隔离 profile 加载 `0.2.0` 插件无异常，tsc 与 639 tests 在 rc5 类型/依赖下通过，真实数据副本的 Learning map / 知识与证据 / 复习 / 洞察 UI 无客户端异常；没有发现需要改插件代码的 API 破坏。 Phase 1–6 的本机 boot 矩阵（2026-10-29）覆盖 `0.2.1-rc.3`、`0.2.1-rc.2`、`0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.1.7-alpha.2` 的插件加载、本地路由、domain v1 与客户端启动；其中 rc3/alpha.2 还通过了 tarball 安装，并用真实模型完成 lesson → Review 评分/撤销 → Insights；rc2/rc20 的完整真实会话仍是补充项。详见 [`docs/planning/COMPATIBILITY.md`](docs/planning/COMPATIBILITY.md)。 Rules this repository enforces mechanically: - **Named exports only.** A `export default` plugin makes Cordis' loader prefer `.default` and **silently drop `inject`** — a documented DSH outage. Pinned by a test that fails if a default export is ever introduced. - **`@deepseek-ai/*` is imported `type`-only**, so the compiler erases it and no second runtime copy can be resolved. Enforced by `verbatimModuleSyntax`, and verified on the built artifact (it contains zero imports). - **No `instanceof` across package boundaries.** Take runtime objects from `ctx`. - Peer ranges name the release lines this plugin was verified on. DSH ships prereleases, and npm's semver only admits a prerelease when its line is named in the range — so the compatibility matrix above, not the range floor, is the contract. Dev dependencies pin one exact cohort for the type baseline. ## UI baseline for redesign The current surfaces, state model and screenshots (generated from fixtures) live in [`docs/design/ui-baseline/index.html`](docs/design/ui-baseline/index.html) with a detailed handoff in [`docs/design/ui-baseline/README.md`](docs/design/ui-baseline/README.md). It covers the system structure, Learning map / Current lesson surfaces, every route-page state and the design constraints a new UI must keep. ## Diagnostics Monitoring is local and content-free: no chat, goal, lesson or evidence text is recorded, and nothing is sent anywhere. ```sh pnpm doctor # human-readable health report node scripts/doctor.mjs --json # machine-readable node scripts/doctor.mjs --strict # exit 1 if an error-severity issue exists ``` It reads `/storages/udt.json` plus the event journal and reports each project's stage, pending/failed tutor requests (with age), stalled attempts and route-length conflicts. The same report is available at `GET /diagnostic-tutor/api/diagnostics` (loopback-only, like every plugin route). The host journal lives at `/logs/diagnostic-tutor-events.jsonl` (`DSH_DIAGNOSTIC_TUTOR_EVENTS` overrides the path, `off` disables it). It logs lifecycle events only: tool names and operations, durations, request outcomes, provider error messages (truncated). A single file is capped at 1 MB and rotated once. --- ## Install **Requirements** | | | | --- | --- | | [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) | verified against `0.2.1-rc.3` | | the [Universal Diagnostic Tutor](https://github.com/SenmuuuuW/universal-diagnostic-tutor-skill) skill | the teaching brain. Without it the runtime loads, records and displays state, but **no lesson is ever written** | | Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` | **Install the plugin** ```sh # `web` is a shipped profile template: it is created on first use with the # base and web-app bundles, so this works on a machine that has never run DSH. dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-diagnostic-tutor ``` Use your own profile name in place of `web` to install into an existing one. `--profile` is **mandatory** — without it `dsh plugin` exits non-zero, because it is a thin pnpm forwarder that needs a profile to forward into. For a new profile that is not one of the shipped names, create it from a template first: ```sh dsh --profile mine --from-default-profile web --dump-config >/dev/null dsh plugin --profile mine add dsh-diagnostic-tutor ``` **Install the skill** The skill is a separate project and is not bundled here — install it where your DSH agent looks for skills (see its README). The runtime works with or without it; without it, nothing writes a lesson. Note that the runtime cannot always *detect* it: see [Known limitations](#known-limitations). **Verify** ```sh # The plugin should appear in the merged tree, as an insert row. dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A2 dsh-diagnostic-tutor ``` Then start the profile and look for **Learn** in the sidebar: ```sh dsh web --port 8399 --no-open ``` A `--dump-config` entry only proves a loader row exists — it is not proof the plugin runs. Opening the panel is: a first run shows *What do you want to learn?*. **Install from a tarball** — the same command with a path: ```sh npm pack dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD/dsh-diagnostic-tutor-0.3.0.tgz" ``` **What gets installed is prebuilt.** The package ships `lib/` — the host half and the browser bundle — plus `cordis.patch.yml`. No build step, no clone, no `pnpm install`, and no `link:` dependency. The only runtime dependency is `zod`; every `@deepseek-ai/*` package is a **peer**, resolved from the harness itself, so a second copy of the DSH runtime is never pulled in. --- ## Learner state and the diagnosis map State lives in one Cordis **storage domain** (`udt`, version 1) over the official `storageDomain` seam. The profile chooses the medium — the standard profiles route it through `dsh-storage-json` under `dshHomePath('storages')` — so this plugin never hardcodes a path. With the json backend you get exactly one document, `/udt.json` (`~/.dsh/storages/udt.json` for a default install): ```json { "unit": { "name": "udt", "version": 1 }, "global": { "initializedAt": "…", "updatedAt": "…", "activeCourseId": "…" }, "tables": { "courses": { "…": {} }, "nodes": { "…": {} } } } ``` | Slot | Holds | | --- | --- | | `global` | the learner singleton — preferences, `initializedAt`, and the legacy shared `activeCourseId` marker | | `tables.courses` | one record per learning goal, in the learner's own words | | `tables.nodes` | the diagnosis map: `id`, `courseId`, `title`, `parentId?`, `relation`, `state`, `evidence[]` | Courses, maps, lessons and evidence are shared by the learner's conversations. Project selection, focus, next step and handoff belong to one conversation, identified by its session ID. The legacy `activeCourseId` remains in storage for compatibility; it does not select a project for a conversation. A fresh conversation starts with the library, even when historical projects exist. | Conversation selection | Project binding | | --- | --- | | `none` | A new goal, or a validated write explicitly naming a course or node in this conversation, may select its project. Reading shared data does not select it. | | `new` | The learner pressed **Start something new**. Only a new goal created here may bind; historical map or lesson writes leave this choice intact. | | `project` | The selected course is the default for tools. Creating another goal does not replace it; writes to another course require selecting that course first. | `udt_status` reports this conversation's `selection` and, only for `project`, its `courseId`. Goal, map and lesson writes return `projectAdopted` and `projectBinding`: `adopted`, `already-selected`, `not-selected`, or `missing-session-id`. A choice made while a write is pending takes precedence over that write's adoption. Without a reliable session ID, status reports `sessionAvailable: false`; explicit shared writes can still be stored, but their result is `missing-session-id` and they claim no conversation binding. Two deliberate rules: - **zod is the contract.** Every record is validated at the durable boundary, so a hand-edited or corrupt document fails loudly instead of entering memory. - **No scores, ever.** There is no field for points, grades or percentages — the skill forbids turning mastery into a score, and a test asserts that no such key exists anywhere in the persisted document. Records are never mutated in place; writes go through `put`/`set` on one per-domain write chain, so concurrent writers cannot interleave. ### How the map is kept from becoming a syllabus The rules are enforced in `src/diagnosis.ts` as pure functions, so no tool can route around them: - a node is **born `unconfirmed`**, and stays there without evidence; - `confirmed` requires a **`check` or `transfer`** evidence entry. Explanation or practice alone never confirms — the skill is explicit that "explanation alone and one lucky answer never confirm readiness"; - a **goal node can never be confirmed**: it is the frame of the map, not a claim about the learner; - every non-goal node must attach to a **parent that already exists** in the same course, and there are no cycles — so the map grows outward from what has been diagnosed, one step at a time; - **at most 8 nodes per call and 40 per course.** A single call cannot plant a term's worth of material; - `relation` is `goal | part-of | prerequisite | related`. There is deliberately no `next-in-course`, because nothing in this runtime knows a teaching order. ### Tools Eighteen. None of them decides anything about teaching; they record or report. | Tool | Does | | --- | --- | | `udt_status` | reports shared goals and counts, plus this conversation's selection, focus and pending next step | | `udt_goal_create` | records a goal and plants only the map root; may also select it for this conversation | | `udt_map_get` | reads the selected project's map, or an explicitly named shared course, with each node's relation, state and evidence | | `udt_map_update` | `add-nodes` · `set-state` · `add-evidence` | | `udt_lesson_update` | writes teaching into the learning surface as blocks; pre-renders math; attaches source citations | | `udt_quiz_update` | records a quiz/flashcard submission; never grades and never changes node state | | `udt_decide_next` | records where the learner should go next, and why | | `udt_path_get` | reads the goal brief, assessment, routes and this conversation's active attempt | | `udt_path_update` | saves a brief, assessment or route proposal | | `udt_course_run_update` | binds a diagnosed node to an attempt, or completes with evidence | | `udt_source_add` | stores pasted text or one explicitly named local `.md`/`.txt` file; deduplicates by SHA-256 | | `udt_source_list` | lists source metadata without content | | `udt_source_get` | returns one stored source for citation | | `udt_plan_get` | reads the learner-owned Today plan | | `udt_plan_update` | adds, completes or removes plan items; planning is policy, not teaching | | `udt_review_add` | queues review cards; scheduling is policy, not mastery | | `udt_review_next` | reads cards due now | | `udt_review_grade` | records a review rating and reschedules; never confirms a node | The division is the architecture: the tutor decides **what** to teach, when to check, and what an answer showed; the runtime decides **what may be stored** and renders it. There is no branch anywhere in this repository that says "if blocked then explain the prerequisite" — that is the skill's call, made in the chat. ### The loop ``` press Start learning → focus recorded (courseId, nodeId, startedAt, status) → the tutor is woken in that conversation with the node named → the tutor teaches into the surface via udt_lesson_update → the learner answers the check in the chat → the tutor judges, records evidence via udt_map_update, decides the next move → the panel follows → the tutor decides the next step with udt_decide_next → the panel shows the recommendation and its reason → the learner presses Continue, and the next node begins ``` ### The decision `action` is the skill's six readiness outcomes, reused rather than re-invented: the words for "what this concept showed" and "where that sends the learner" are the same words. The runtime only needs one structural fact about each — whether it names a target: | outcome | target | means | | --- | --- | --- | | `advance` / `advance-with-caution` | required | move there | | `step-down` | required | the blocker; usually a prerequisite | | `review-first` | optional | go back, or review here | | `more-practice` / `diagnose-again` | forbidden | stay here | A move ends the focus and stamps `endedAt`; staying leaves it open. Nothing moves on its own — the learner reads the reason and presses Continue. ### The wait, measured Moving to a node is not instant, so the wait is a **persisted record** keyed by target node — which makes it idempotent, refresh-proof, restart-proof and retryable — and it carries a timestamp per stage: ``` requestedAt → focusRecordedAt → promptedAt → firstActivityAt → lessonAt → observedAt ``` The same record is the progress line (`focus recorded` → `tutor requested` → `tutor working` → `lesson ready`, with elapsed seconds) and the measurement. A real run against DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2 and the real skill: | stage | when | | --- | --- | | focus persisted | 0.0s | | followup accepted | 0.0s | | first tutor activity | 1.0s | | lesson written | 26.1s | | UI observed | 26.1s | **The plugin costs about a second; the rest is the model writing.** A stall is derived from the record rather than stored, and retrying never touches the focus — a timeout is a statement about the wait, not about where the learner is. `Start learning` is a **user-role turn attributed to this plugin**, not injected context: `agent.inject()` would add model-visible context without waking an idle agent, so nothing would happen until the learner typed. Opening a turn is what the button means. ### Two surfaces, one state | Surface | Where | For | | --- | --- | --- | | **Learning map** | the main column (`main`, key `diagnostic-tutor-map`) | browsing — course route, every lesson Overview, knowledge & evidence | | **Current lesson** | the right sidebar tab, beside the chat | the lesson itself — teaching units, and checks answered in the chat | One page for browsing, one surface for learning. The page never starts a lesson; the tab never decides what to teach. Both read the same `useLearning` state and the same path client, so they cannot disagree about what is focused, accepted or written. **Open current lesson** on the map returns to the conversation with the lesson tab open in the same step. The container for the main column is the map page. A full-page lesson panel used to exist as a second main destination; it was removed so the same lesson is not offered in two places. The standalone full-page component is still used by the preview and the tests, but the plugin does not register it. ### Teaching-brain detection Each overview asks the platform's own Agent and Skill registries whether the Universal Diagnostic Tutor skill is available in the requesting session's live Agent scope and cwd. No path is hardcoded, no skill root is assumed, and nothing is copied. Missing services and incomplete discovery return an inconclusive status; complete scoped discovery can establish presence or absence. Compatibility is probed by **capability**, not by a version string: the skill's maintenance contract permits only `name` and `description` in frontmatter, so it cannot declare a version. The result carries a short content digest as a version hint. Paths, fingerprints and compatibility details stay **internal**, absent from every tool output and overview. The overview exposes only availability. The skill forbids naming its files, versions or repository in learner-facing text. ### How the two halves agree The skill's guardrails say mastery tracking must never become "scores, databases, hidden memory, or a curriculum roadmap", while this runtime deliberately persists state and renders a map. Until `v0.0.8` that tension was bridged from this side: a short system-prompt section explained the runtime's storage semantics to the teaching brain. UDT v2.1's `learning_runtime_contract.md` now states all of it in the skill's own words — what a runtime may hold, when a decision is recorded, and that a turn which judged an answer is *not finished* until the next step is recorded — so the bridge was **deleted rather than kept as a second voice**. The plugin got better at it, which is the evidence it belonged upstream. ## The page and the lesson surface The browser half registers three things: the **Learning map** icon in the sidebar (`sidebar.panellist`, a `list`), the page it opens (`main`, a `keyed` slot, key `diagnostic-tutor-map`), and the **Current lesson** tab in the right sidebar (a tab type plus its body and title). The map's sidebar `id` and its `main` key come from one constant — a drift between them would leave the icon opening nothing. The page has two tabs: **Course route** (the versioned plan, route canvas, ordered lesson list and every Overview) and **Knowledge & evidence** (the diagnosis map and its recorded observations). Neither one teaches: they show stored state. The route tab shows one stage at a time and one next step. A progress bar names the four stages — goal & time, initial diagnosis, route, learning — and a **Next step** card always answers "what now?" with a single primary action (set the goal, request or answer the diagnosis, request the route, accept the version, start the first lesson, continue the current one) plus at most one real alternative. Competing action rows live in the folded history, not beside it. Before a goal is saved the wizard owns the page; while the tutor is asking diagnostic questions the card points back to the conversation, shows how long it has waited, says whether the tutor is still thinking, and on a failed turn retries with the current model and opens the chat (the failure is recorded on the path request, so it survives a restart; provider errors are translated into billing / auth / rate-limit / network / context advice); route versions appear only after the diagnosis is complete or skipped; once accepted, the page leads with the route canvas. A proposed or accepted route shows its total study time, the weeks it takes at the saved weekly budget, and any lessons longer than the preferred session. Next step moves to the first unfinished lesson after a completion, and says when the whole route is done. Completed diagnosis details and route settings stay reachable in folded sections. The plugin's own accent is **DeepSeek's brand blue** — `#4d6bfe` on the light canvas, `#6a84ff` on the dark one — used sparingly for progress, the active tab, the current/selected item, focus rings and action links. Primary buttons keep the host's near-black/white fill: the blue marks, it does not act. All other colours continue to come from the host theme. The initial diagnosis is asked through DSH's **interactive question card** (`ask_user_question`) when the profile provides it: options are tapped rather than typed, multi-select works, and a free-text question covers explanations. The tutor still owns the questions, evidence and assessment; profiles without that tool fall back to chat text. The lesson lives in the docked tab, where the conversation is still on screen. That is what makes the check loop work without leaving the lesson. The sidebar action **Learn** opens that tab and never takes over the main column; the map's **Open current lesson** button returns to the conversation and opens the same tab. ``` sidebar Learn ─────────────▶ Current lesson (right sidebar) sidebar Learning map ──────▶ Learning map (main column: route | knowledge) Open current lesson ◀────── returns to chat + lesson tab ``` Entering learning follows the conversation, not the window. A project is shared, but its focus and planned runs belong to a conversation, so the project library and **Open current lesson** ask the host which conversation was last learning the project (`GET /project/session`, read-only) and switch there with the shell's session navigation when it differs. The order is: newest active focus, then newest course run with an attempt, then newest project selection; only a project no conversation has ever touched falls back to the conversation on screen. A full-page lesson panel used to exist as a second main destination. It was removed: one page for browsing, one surface for learning, and the conversation keeps the main column. ### Learning Blocks A block is `{ id, type, content, metadata? }`. The **schema is host-side** (zod-validated at the durable boundary) and the **renderers are browser-side**, keyed by `type`: | Type | Content | | --- | --- | | `text` | `md` — markdown, plus host `math[]` fragments for typeset formulas | | `example` | `title`, `steps[]`, `takeaway?` | | `diagram` | `format` (`ascii` \| `mermaid`), `spec`, `caption?` | | `check` | `prompt`, `expect?`, `hint?` — the stop-and-wait surface | | `formula` | `tex`, `display?`, host-rendered `mathml`, `capt

# CatPaw (妙手) bridge for DeepSeek Harness

![test](https://github.com/Smartloe/dsh-catpaw/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)

把妙手（CatPaw）桌面端背后的模型接进 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)（DSH）的模型选择器：12 个真实模型、可调推理等级、可回传真实工具调用，并且扫码登录后不再依赖妙手 App 常驻。

> **先说适用范围。** 模型请求走 `ai.catpaw.meituan.com`，登录走 `catx.nocode.cn`，两者都是美团内网服务。**只有拥有美团账号（Passport 或 EPassport）并且能访问内网的人才能真正用起来。** 这个仓库公开的意义是分享实现，不是给外部用户提供一个可用的模型源。

## 它做了什么

妙手不是本地模型，也没有 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容接口。它的模型只能通过本机的 `catpaw-cli` 访问，而该进程只绑 `127.0.0.1` 的随机端口，用 JSON-RPC 2.0 + SSE 通信。

本插件在 DSH 的 `llm` 服务上注册一个 `catpaw` provider，把 DSH 的一次模型调用翻译成一次 CatPaw agent run，再把流式结果翻译回 DSH 的 `StreamChunk`：

```
DSH agent loop
  → ctx.llm.stream({ provider:'catpaw', model, messages, system, tools })
  → CatPawAdapter.stream()
  → catpaw-cli server (POST /api, stream:true, text/event-stream)
  → CatPaw cloud
  → model_chunk { content, reasoningContent }
  → StreamChunk (reasoning-delta / text-delta / tool-call / finish)
```

三个关键点：

- **真实模型表**：来自妙手的 `POST /api/agent/maas/model-types`（`tenant=CatDesk`、`scene=CATX_APP`、`env=EXTERNAL`），不是 `product.json` 里那几个内部 ID。
- **推理等级**：每个模型按它支持的参数（`context` / `thinking` / `effort`）暴露不同的档位，经 `dynamicContext.requestContext.modelParams` 传给服务端。
- **工具调用**：CLI 只会流文本，所以工具调用走一个显式文本协议，插件解析成真的 `tool-call` 块，由 DSH 执行、DSH 掌握审批。

## 目录

```
.
├── package.json             dsh.bundle 清单 + 包入口（仓库根即插件包）
├── index.js                 provider、流解析、工具协议、登录工具
├── login.mjs                扫码登录（纯 HTTP，不依赖 Electron）
├── cordis.patch.yml         默认模型表
├── locale/                  中英文显示名
├── icon.svg                 插件图标
├── bin/catpaw-cli           妙手自带的 agent CLI（见版权说明）
├── examples/
│   └── headless-catpaw.yml  无头冒烟测试用的 patch
└── CLAUDE.md                仓库内的开发指引
```

## 快速开始

**1. 准备 CLI。** 仓库里的 `bin/catpaw-cli` 直接可用；如果缺了，从妙手 App 里拷一份：

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.catpaw-dsh/bin
cp "/Applications/妙手.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar.unpacked/node_modules/@catpaw/agent-sdk/bin/catpaw-cli" ~/.catpaw-dsh/bin/
chmod +x ~/.catpaw-dsh/bin/catpaw-cli
```

解析顺序：配置项 `cliPath` → 环境变量 `CATPAW_CLI` → 仓库内 `bin/catpaw-cli` → `~/.catpaw-dsh/bin/catpaw-cli` → 妙手 App 包内。

仓库里的副本是 **macOS arm64** 的；在别的平台用 `cliPath` 指向你自己那份（妙手 App 里的同款二进制）。

**2. 安装插件。**

```sh
# 从 GitHub 安装（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Smartloe/dsh-catpaw

# 本地仓库已 clone 时，在 DSH 会话里也可以
plugin_manager install_bundle target=<repo>
```

启用 `dsh-catpaw`，模型选择器里就会出现 **CatPaw (妙手)**。

**3. 扫码登录。** 对 agent 说「扫码登录妙手」，它会调用 `catpaw_login` 返回授权链接；浏览器完成扫码后凭据自动写入 `~/.meituan-catpaw/auth.json`，下一次调用自动生效，不用重启。`catpaw_auth_status` 可以随时查状态；说不清哪里不对时，让 agent 调 `catpaw_doctor`——它一次性报告：CLI 解析到哪份二进制、凭据是否还有效、网关是否可达、**线上模型表与配置是否一致**、本地服务是否在跑，以及当前生效的设置。

## 模型

| modelType | 名称 | 推理等级 |
|---|---|---|
| 10002544 | LongCat-2.5 | 关闭思考 / 深度思考 |
| 77 | LongCat-2.0 | 关闭思考 / 深度思考 |
| 98 | GLM-5.3-FlashX | 低 / 中 / 高 |
| 91 | GLM-5.3-Flash | 低 / 中 / 高 |
| 89 | GLM-5.3 | 低 / 中 / 高 |
| 97 | DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash | 关闭思考 / 低 / 中 / 高 |
| 64 | DeepSeek-V4-Pro | 关闭思考 / 低 / 中 / 高 |
| 10002518 | MiniMax-M3.1-Flash | 低 / 中 / 高（默认低） |
| 70 | MiniMax-M3 | 关闭思考 / 深度思考 |
| 10002533 | Kimi-K3.1-Pro | 关闭思考 / 低 / 中 / 高 |
| 83 | Kimi-K3 | 关闭思考 / 低 / 中 / 高 |
| 0 | Auto | — |

上下文默认 1M（`context: "1024000"`）。等级映射：

- `off` → `thinking: { enabled: false }`
- `low` / `high` / `max` → `thinking: { enabled: true }` + `effort: "low"|"high"|"max"`

## 工具调用

1. prompt 里用 `<tools>` 段列出所有 Harness 工具（名称、描述、紧凑参数 schema）。
2. 模型要动手时必须输出：

```
<<<catpaw_tool_call>>>
[{"name":"dsh_bash","arguments":{"command":"uuidgen"}}]
<<<end_catpaw_tool_call>>>
```

3. 插件把这段解析成真实的 `tool-call` 块，**由 DSH 执行并掌管审批**，妙手不参与。
4. 结果作为 `tool_result` 在下一轮回到模型。

启动 catpaw-cli 时会把妙手自带的 19 个工具用 `excludeTools` 全部排除（`excludeNativeTools: true`，默认开），模型手里只剩标记块这一条路——这是工具调用成功率从约 1/3 提到 13/14 的关键。协议在 transcript 之后还会重申一次（recency）。没有原生工具可调时，模型会把自己训练时的格式当正文吐出来——LongCat 的 `<longcat_tool_call>`、DeepSeek 的 `<｜｜DSML｜｜ invoke>`——插件都能解析（`parseLongcatCalls` / `parseDsmlCalls`），所以三种写法都能落地；提示词里也明确禁止输出 XML 标签。

## 配置

写在插件条目的 `config` 里（见 `cordis.patch.yml`）：

| 键 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `models` | 上表 12 个 | 模型目录；每项含 `id`、`name`、`contextWindow`、`maxTokens`、`params`、可选 `defaultEffort` |
| `cliPath` | 自动解析 | CLI 二进制路径 |
| `authPath` | `~/.meituan-catpaw/auth.json` | 凭据文件 |
| `baseURL` | `https://ai.catpaw.meituan.com` | 模型端点 |
| `gateway` | `https://catx.nocode.cn` | 登录网关（模型调用仍用 `baseURL`） |
| `permissionMode` | `dontAsk` | 妙手自身工具循环的权限模式 |
| `excludeNativeTools` | `true` | 关掉妙手自带的工具（`bash`/`read_file`/… 共 19 个）。`true` 用内置名单，数组则按名单，`false` 保留 |
| `systemPrompt` | `transcript` | `transcript` 把 DSH 的 system prompt 放进 `<system>`；`none` 保留妙手原生提示 |
| `maxPromptChars` | `120000` | 单轮 prompt 字符预算，超出丢最旧的消息 |
| `toolResultChars` | `4000` | 单条工具结果截断 |
| `messageChars` | `20000` | 单条消息截断 |
| `timeoutMs` / `idleTimeoutMs` | `600000` / `300000` | 总超时 / 无 SSE 帧超时 |
| `debug` | `false` | 打印 CLI 的 stdout/stderr |

## 登录是怎么工作的

妙手的扫码登录本身是纯 HTTP，不需要 Electron：

```
GET  https://catx.nocode.cn/api/gateway/passport/login-config   -> { loginEntryUrl }
open {loginEntryUrl}?state=<hex>&redirect=http://127.0.0.1:<port>/callback&sid=<hex>
race: 本地回调 (?token=&state=)  vs  GET /api/gateway/passport/poll-token?sid=<hex>
write ~/.meituan-catpaw/auth.json
```

个人（Passport）账号**不返回 refresh token**——妙手自己在该 provider 上标注 `canRefresh: false`——所以 token 过期只能重新扫码。企业（EPassport）账号走 `passport.catpaw.meituan.com` 的 device code 流程，会返回 refresh token。

## 验证

```sh
cd <repo>
node --test                        # 54 个用例，不联网
dsh headless --patch ./examples/headless-catpaw.yml "只回复两个字：你好"

# 安装形态（= 用户 `dsh plugin add` 之后的样子）：打包、装进一个临时 DSH profile、
# 组合配置、跑一句真模型调用，并确认用的是插件自带的那份 catpaw-cli
./scripts/verify-bundle.sh           # 加 --offline 只验组合不调模型
```

期望 stdout 输出 `你好`、退出码 `0`。这条路径加载的就是 `index.js`，和 GUI 走同一份代码。

工具调用可以用一个模型猜不到的输入验证：

```sh
echo -n "nonce-$(date +%s)" > /tmp/probe.txt
dsh headless --patch ./examples/headless-catpaw.yml "用 bash 执行 cat /tmp/probe.txt，把内容原样告诉我"
```

## 常见问题

| 现象 | 原因与处理 |
|---|---|
| 回答只出来一半，或者同一段重复两次 | 1.0.x 的流式 bug（把增量当快照）。1.1.0 起已修；确认装的是新版本 |
| 模型说"我将执行…"但什么都没做 | 它调了妙手自带工具、被拒后开始解释。1.1.0 起默认 `excludeNativeTools: true` 会把这些工具从模型手里拿走；若你手动改过这行，改回 `true` |
| 报 `interaction_pending` | `permissionMode` 停在需要人工确认的模式。设成 `dontAsk` |
| 报 401 / 403，或提示"登录态可能已失效" | token 过期。让 agent 调 `catpaw_login` 重新扫码 |
| 说不清哪里不对 | 让 agent 调 `catpaw_doctor`，它会把 CLI 路径、凭据、网关、模型表一致性、本地服务与生效设置一次列出来 |
| 报"catpaw-cli 没有执行权限" | 二进制丢了 +x。`chmod +x` 那份文件；`catpaw_doctor` 也会点名这个 |
| 报"找不到 catpaw-cli" | 用 `cliPath` 指到你那份二进制；仓库自带的是 macOS arm64 |
| 一直转圈，最后超时 | 后端卡住或网络抖动。默认 5 分钟无内容帧就中止，并通知后端停止；可调 `idleTimeoutMs` / `timeoutMs` |
| 长会话后模型忘了前面说过什么 | 单轮 prompt 有字符上限（`maxPromptChars`，默认 12 万），超出会丢最旧的消息，并在 prompt 里注明省略了多少条 |
| 工具结果的中间部分不见了 | 单条结果超过 `toolResultChars`（默认 4000）时保留首尾、省略中间 |

## 已知限制

- 模型请求是本机 `catpaw-cli` 进程，只绑 `127.0.0.1`，只有本机能调。
- 工具调用依赖模型遵守文本协议；不遵守时会退化成纯文本回答，重试或换模型（LongCat-2.5 与 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 实测可用）。
- 个人账号 token 无法自动续期，到期需重新扫码。
- 每轮都把整段对话渲染进 prompt，长会话重复发送上下文；`maxPromptChars` 会丢弃最旧的消息。

## 版权与许可

源代码以 MIT 发布，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

**`bin/catpaw-cli` 是美团（Meituan）所有的专有二进制，不随本仓库的 MIT 条款授权。** 它在这里只为方便取用；使用与再分发请遵循其所有者允许的范围。本项目引用的内网服务端点同样归美团所有，本许可证不授予你对它们的任何权利。

# dsh-usage-stats · 会话与用量

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的用量仪表盘插件：从真实的会话投影缓存里统计 **token 消耗、估算成本、会话数、缓存命中率**，并展示 **月度预算水位** 与 **宿主进程运行状态（CPU / 内存 / 事件循环 / 运行时长）**。

界面按官方「会话统计」宣传片的工作台排版复刻，单页滚动，无第三方依赖。

## 安装

把仓库地址发给 DSH 里的助手，说「装这个插件」：

```
github:Stopning/dsh-usage-stats
```

助手会走 bundle 机制安装并自动排期重启。装好后侧栏出现「会话与用量」，位于「插件」与「自动化任务」之间。

> 别手改 profile 的 `package.json` 或 `cordis.patch.yml`，也别拷进 `node_modules` 手动改 —— 那样升级会丢。

![面板截图](docs/screenshot.png)

---

## 功能

**KPI 卡（随顶部时间范围联动）**

| 卡片 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 总 Token 消耗 | 四类 token 合计，副标拆出未缓存输入 / 输出 |
| 预估成本 | 按模型目录价折算的人民币金额，副标注明计价口径 |
| 会话数 | 范围内会话总量，副标给出平均每会话 token |
| 缓存命中率 | `cacheRead / (cacheRead + uncached)`，副标为缓存读取总量 |

**DSH 运行状态**（每 5 秒采样，与官方一致；`CPU_HISTORY = 60` 个点正好铺满最近 5 分钟）

- CPU（单核）百分比 + 整机负载 + 核数
- 内存 RSS + V8 堆已用 / 堆总量
- 事件循环延迟 p99 与均值（`monitorEventLoopDelay`，每次采样后 reset）
- 进程运行时长、PID、Node 版本
- 最近 5 分钟 CPU 柱状图 + 峰值

**每日消耗**：按 token 类型堆叠的四色柱状图，右上角显示范围总量与金额。

**模型花费**：按模型列出金额与占比条。

**会话消耗排行**：可切换「按 Token / 按花费 / 按耗时」，取值随档位联动显示（耗时档显示耗时 + 轮次，花费档显示金额 + token）。

**Token 构成**：环形图 + 四项明细（缓存读取 / 未缓存输入 / 缓存写入 / 输出）及百分比。

**对话性能**：平均每轮耗时、平均首字延迟（TTFT）、输出速度（tok/s）、工具错误率。

**月度预算**

- 统计**固定为当前自然月**，不随顶部范围变化
- 点击金额即可就地编辑上限，回车保存、Esc 取消；值存在插件私有文件里，刷新不丢
- 鲸鱼水位按 `已用 / 上限` 的比例从底部填充，四档换色：

| 区间 | 颜色 |
|---|---|
| < 30% | 绿 `#31BD9D` |
| 30% – 60% | 黄 `#E0B23C` |
| 60% – 90% | 橙 `#F08A24` |
| ≥ 90% | 红 `#E2453C` |

---

## 安装细节

插件通过 DSH 的 bundle 机制安装，**不要手改 profile 的 `package.json` 或 `cordis.patch.yml`**。

对助手说「装这个插件」，或直接指定来源：

```
github:Stopning/dsh-usage-stats          # 从 GitHub
/path/to/dsh-usage-stats                 # 从本地路径
```

底层走的是 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`：

```bash
plugin_manager{ action: "install_bundle", target: "github:Stopning/dsh-usage-stats" }
```

生效方式：

- 修改 `client.js` → **刷新页面**即可（客户端 bundle 的 revision 由文件 mtime + size 算出）；
- 修改 `index.js` → **重启宿主**。可排队等空闲重启：`~/.dsh/bin/dsh-restart-idle`。


---

## 数据来源

插件不解析原始会话日志，读的是 DSH 已经维护好的两份缓存：

| 数据 | 位置 / 通道 |
|---|---|
| 每会话 token、耗时、按天成本 | `storageDomain` → `session_projcache` → `sessions` 表 |
| 宿主进程指标 | `node:os` + `node:perf_hooks`，进程内直接采样 |

会话记录里用到的主要字段：

```js
record.rows.tokenUsage.val.totals     // { uncachedInputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheWriteTokens }
record.rows.sessionStats.val          // { turns, steps, llmMs, toolMs, ttftMs, ttftSteps, decodeMs, decodeTokens }
record.rows.contextActivity.val.days  // { 'YYYY-MM-DD': { tokens, turns, wallMs, cost: { provider: { model: { peak|off: {...} } } } } }
record.rows.modelSelection.val.lastUsed // { provider, model }
record.rows.title.val                 // 会话标题
```

按天成本由 `contextActivity.days[date].cost` 的四类 token 乘以价目表得到。价目表按四级回退：**模型定价 → 本渠道 provider 定价 → 跨渠道 `proxied` 定价 → 默认价兜底**（兜底时该模型标记为「估算」）。成本换算只做一次，宿主下发 `cost.display`，客户端不再乘汇率。

### 关于月度预算的存储

预算上限不在 profile 配置里，而是插件自己的文件：

```
~/.dsh/storages/dsh-usage-stats/budget.json
{ "amount": 100, "updatedAt": "2026-11-03T19:36:16.225Z" }
```

这个文件**优先于** `Config.budgetAmount`。改值请走面板上的就地编辑或接口：

```bash
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:<port>/api/dsh-usage-stats/budget \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Cookie: dsh-auth-...' \
  -d '{"amount": 100}'
```

> ⚠️ 直接写 `budget.json` 不生效：宿主进程内存里的 `settings.budgetAmount` 才是权威值，只有走路由才会同步。改了文件不重启，面板仍按旧值算。

---

## HTTP 接口

四条路由，均为 `POST`，返回 `{ ok: true, value: ... }`：

| 路由 | 请求体 | 返回 |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/dsh-usage-stats/overview` | `{ range?, currency? }` | KPI、每日消耗、模型花费、Token 构成、对话性能、月度预算 |
| `/api/dsh-usage-stats/sessions` | `{ range?, limit?, currency? }` | 会话列表（含按天明细） |
| `/api/dsh-usage-stats/budget` | `{ amount }` | 写入后的预算上限 |
| `/api/dsh-usage-stats/cpu` | — | 一次宿主进程快照 |

`range` 可选 `24h` / `7d` / `14d` / `30d` / `all`。

---

## 配置

在 profile 的插件配置里覆盖（全部可选）：

```yaml
budgetAmount: 100        # 月度预算上限，被 budget.json 覆盖
budgetPeriod: month      # 目前只支持 month
defaultRange: 30d        # 默认时间范围
refreshIntervalMs: 5000  # CPU 采样与刷新间隔
topSessions: 200         # 一览里最多取多少会话
currency: CNY            # 计价货币
```

---

## 计价口径与已知限制

- **成本是估算，不是账单。** 价目表来自 models.dev 的 list price，未命中时回退到默认价并在界面标注「估算」。与实际扣费可能有出入，尤其在有折扣、套餐额度或峰谷计价的渠道。
- **缓存写入常为 0。** 多数渠道不上报 `cacheWriteTokens`，因此「缓存写入」一栏通常为零。
- **首字延迟与输出速度只能取全会话累计值。** `contextActivity.days` 的日桶里没有逐日 ttft / decode 数据，所以这两项不随顶部范围变化，其余「对话性能」指标随范围联动。
- **工具错误率来自命令统计**，粒度是「命令执行失败 / 命令执行总数」，不含非命令类工具调用。
- **预算按自然月**，不提供自定义起止日期。
- 面板高度固定在宿主中心列里，内容超出时面板内部滚动。

---

## 开发

零运行时依赖，源码两个文件：

| 文件 | 角色 |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host 半边：读投影缓存、算成本、采样 CPU、注册四条路由 |
| `client.js` | Client 半边：单页仪表盘 UI（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 注册） |
| `locale/{zh,en}.json` | 清单用的标题与描述 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 注入声明 |
| `DESIGN.md` | 设计文档：排版、字段来源、实现决定与踩坑记录 |

> `index.js` 里自带一个 ~40 行的 `defineConfig`（standard-schema 最小实现）。之所以不引 zod：bundle 以符号链接装进 profile，裸导入会走工作区真实路径去找 `node_modules`，装了反而 `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`；而 Cordis 只要求 `Config["~standard"].validate()` 存在。

### 验证

```bash
# 宿主侧：用真实的投影缓存跑一遍路由，打印真实返回
node verify.host.mjs

# 界面侧：无头浏览器打开面板并截图（需要 playwright）
python3 verify.ui.py <port> [cookie] [out.png]
```

`verify.ui.py` 会自动从桌面版 Chromium 的 cookie 库里读最新的 `dsh-auth-*` cookie。可用环境变量覆盖：`UST_CHROME`（浏览器二进制路径）、`UST_COOKIE_DB`（cookie 库路径）。

### 改界面时

- 客户端改动 → 刷新页面。bundle revision 由 `mtime + size` 算出，文件变了就会重新拉取。
- 宿主改动 → 重启 DSH。
- 样式只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token，别写死颜色，否则深色/浅色皮肤下会翻车（踩过：`--dsw-alias-brand-primary` 在浅色皮肤下是近黑色）。

---

decision.reason: Held for versioned DSH compatibility. MIT, documented Git source and checked-in native host/client exist, but no versioned DSH compatibility declaration was found. It reads credentials, model usage and session metadata and stores local statistics; privacy and accounting correctness remain runtime questions. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# Tavotto 的 Codex 插件 让 Codex 画的 matplotlib 图**在 Codex 里就能用鼠标改完、体检完、导出投稿**： ``` 用户: 用这个 CSV 画温度与去除率的折线图，要 error bar，适合论文 ↓ Codex + 本插件的技能: 写 figures/fig_removal_rate.py → 跑 → Fig1_removal_rate.pdf ↓ Codex 调 tavotto_open_figure: 在对话里开出一块交互画布 ↓ 用户: 拖图例、改字号线宽、调刻度 → 跑出版规范预检 → 导出真矢量 PDF ↓（需要拼版、加标注、多图排版时） tavotto open: 交给 Tavotto 桌面窗口接着排 ``` 分工三层，边界很清楚： | 层 | 是什么 | 负责什么 | | --- | --- | --- | | **技能** `skills/tavotto-figure/` | 一份约定 + 模板 | 教 Codex 写出「Tavotto 接得住」的脚本；数据、坐标、图形结构归代码 | | **MCP server** `mcp/` | 本地 stdio 进程 | 引擎会话、override、出版规范预检、真矢量导出。**没有 UI 的 host 里这九个工具就能走完整条流程** | | **MCP App 画布** `mcp/widget/canvas.html` | Codex 内嵌 iframe | 用鼠标改图。复用 Tavotto 前端**同一份**画布代码，不是另一套实现 | 改动一律是 **override**（`gid + prop + value`），**你的 Python 源码一个字都不改**。 ## 安装 本仓库同时是一个 Codex 插件市场（仓库根的 `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`）： ```bash # 从 GitHub 装（两条分开跑，别用 &&——好判断是哪一步失败）。市场清单指向 # 发行分支 plugin-stable（git-subdir 来源，ADR 0043）：装到的是 CI 构建并验证过的 # 完整插件（含内嵌画布），不需要 Node，也不从源码 checkout 里取任何东西。 codex plugin marketplace add Tavotto/Tavotto --sparse .agents/plugins codex plugin add tavotto@tavotto # 更新 codex plugin marketplace upgrade tavotto # 本地开发时装工作副本：仓库根的市场清单指向发行分支，所以要用插件目录里的 dev 市场 # （codex-plugin/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json，名字 tavotto-dev，不随插件发出去）； # 先 python scripts/build_mcp_widget.py 构建一次画布——它不进 git，装到的是你刚构建的那份 codex plugin marketplace add /path/to/tavotto/codex-plugin codex plugin add tavotto@tavotto-dev ``` 装完（以及每次升级插件、装好引擎之后）**必须新开一个 Codex 会话/线程**： 已经开着的会话**不会**重新加载 MCP 工具——`codex plugin list` 显示 installed/enabled 只说明插件装上了，不代表当前会话拿得到工具，也不代表 MCP server 健康（健康与否用下面的 `--health` 查）。CLI 里用 `$tavotto-figure` 显式调用技能，或者直接说「画张图」让它隐式命中； MCP 工具由 Codex 按需调用（也可以直接说「用 Tavotto 打开这张图」）。 还需要机器上有 Tavotto 本体： * 桌面版（推荐）： * 命令行版：`pipx install "tavotto[worker]"`（`[worker]` 带渲染栈；不带它就是 轻量 CLI，渲染与 MCP 集成要靠你自己指定的解释器） **只装桌面版就够了**——不需要另外装 Python/Conda，也不需要配任何环境变量。 插件会按下面的顺序找到 Tavotto 的命令行入口，前面的赢： 1. `TAVOTTO_CLI` 环境变量（高级覆盖） 2. PATH 里的 `tavotto`（pip / pipx 装的） 3. **安装清单** `install.json`（桌面版装完就有，记着 CLI 的绝对路径） 4. **已知安装位置**里的 `tavotto-cli`（清单丢了照样能找到） 5. Windows 上 HKCU 记着的安装位置（只当补充） 6. 当前解释器里的 `tavotto` 模块 桌面安装包里带的 `tavotto-cli` 是一个 **console 版**命令行，与界面共用同一份 运行时。装出来的 `Tavotto.exe` 是 GUI 程序，**不能当命令行调**（没有真终端时 它的 stdout 会落进日志文件，调用方拿不到那行 JSON）——所以才有这一个。 自检：`tavotto doctor --json`（不起界面、不联网）。完整协议、错误码与排障见 [`../docs/handoff-protocol.md`](../docs/handoff-protocol.md)。 ### MCP server 对环境的要求与交接**不一样** 交接只要能**执行** `tavotto open`，上面那条 `tavotto-cli` 完全够用。但 MCP server 是一个 Python 模块——它要 `import tavotto.engine.*` 在进程内驱动渲染 引擎，而 `tavotto-cli` 是打包成单文件的可执行程序，**给不出解释器**。 所以： | 你装的 | 交接（`tavotto open`） | MCP 工具与内嵌画布 | | --- | --- | --- | | `pipx install "tavotto[worker]"` | ✅ | ✅ | | 桌面版 + pipx | ✅ | ✅ | | **只有桌面版** | ✅ | ❌ 报 `desktop_only`——一条命令补上（见下） | | 都没装 | ❌ | ❌ 报 `tavotto_missing` | 启动器（`mcp/server.py`）按固定优先级找一个**验证过能 `import tavotto.engine`** 的解释器，前面的赢： 1. 启动它的那个 `python3` 本身 2. `TAVOTTO_MCP_PYTHON`（显式指给 MCP 的；指错了会指名道姓地报 `engine_unavailable`，不会悄悄换别的） 3. `TAVOTTO_WORKER_PYTHON` / 设置里指定的渲染解释器（装了 tavotto 才算数） 4. **插件自管环境**（下面 `--provision` 建的那个） 5. 从 `tavotto` 命令行反推（pip/pipx console script 的 shebang） 6. PATH 里的 `python3` / `python` 每个候选都真的跑一遍 import 才算数——桌面版的 frozen `tavotto-cli` 永远不会被误当成解释器。 ### 只装了桌面版：一条命令补齐引擎（零手工配置） ```bash python3 <插件目录>/mcp/server.py --provision ``` 它在 **Tavotto 用户配置目录**下建一个插件专属 venv（`mcp-runtime/venv`）， 装与插件同版本的 `tavotto[worker]`（钉版本可复现；`[worker]` 带上 matplotlib/numpy 渲染栈——pip 形态的引擎发现不了桌面 App 里的内置 runtime，自管环境必须自己能渲染）。**不碰**系统 Python、Conda、 用户 site-packages 或 shell 配置；它的 pip / matplotlib 缓存也在这个目录里 （`mcp-runtime/cache`），删掉 `mcp-runtime` 目录即卸载。离线环境 用 `--from /path/to/tavotto-x.y.z-py3-none-any.whl`（或源码目录）。 装完**新开一个 Codex 会话**。 跑这条命令的 `python3` **可以很老**（macOS 自带的是 3.9）：它只负责找一个 Python 3.10–3.14 来建 venv——当前解释器、PATH 上的 `python3.14…3.10`、 Homebrew / python.org / Windows `py` 启动器的常见位置都会试一遍，每个都真的 跑起来问版本。机器上一个都没有时它以 `no_supported_python` 失败并逐个说出 版本（不会在老 Python 上跑 pip 然后留下一句误导的 "No matching distribution found"）；装一个 Python 3.10–3.14 后重跑即可，或 `--python <解释器路径>` 明确指一个。 ### 健康检查 ```bash python3 <插件目录>/mcp/server.py --health ``` 一行 JSON 说清：引擎找没找到（以及 resolver 每一步的结论与耗时）、画布产物 在不在、桌面版装没装。它能区分开在 `codex plugin list` 里长得一模一样的 几种状态：插件装了但没引擎（`desktop_only` / `tavotto_missing`）、引擎装了但版本 对不上（`engine_too_old` / `engine_incompatible`，带版本号与升级命令；pip 配了镜像时提示镜像 可能滞后并给出 `--index-url https://pypi.org/simple` 的写法）、显式指的 解释器用不了（`engine_unavailable`）、一切就绪但**当前会话还没重载工具** （health 是绿的，那就新开会话）。 新会话里再调用 MCP 工具 `tavotto_health`，它会额外报告真实 initialize 握手： client/version/protocol、宿主实际声明的 capability 名称、可信根来源、generation、 Roots 兼容状态与连接内工作区确认状态。这里不按 Codex 版本号猜能力。 「只有桌面版」这一格**绝不会被说成「没装 Tavotto」**——你明明装了，缺的只是 一个 Python 环境，两者可以共存。启动器找不到可用解释器时不会静默退出，而是起 一个**降级 server**：握手正常（`serverInfo.version` 固定为 `0`，这是「引擎 不在」的显性信号），tools/list **只列真的可用的 `tavotto_health`**——不可用 的八个工具不会被伪装成可用；对着旧会话里记住的工具名调用会得到结构化错误 （code + 缺什么 + 恢复步骤），**绝不会**返回「画布已打开」之类的成功。 定位规则本身**不在这里重复**：启动器直接调用 `skills/tavotto-figure/scripts/handoff.py` 的 `find_tavotto()`（它是 `src/tavotto/engine/locate.py` 的镜像，两侧有跨平台矩阵测试比对）。 ### 内嵌画布与桌面窗口是两条隔离的路 * **Codex 内嵌画布**只跑在 MCP server 里：画布资源 `ui://tavotto/canvas/v1.html` 经 `resources/read` 交给 host，widget 与 引擎的一切往来走 MCP `tools/call`。它**从不**打开浏览器、从不唤起桌面 窗口——那两样不是内嵌画布的替代品，插件也绝不会拿它们冒充。 * **桌面窗口**只在你明确要求交接时出现（`tavotto open` / 技能的 handoff）。它有自己的就绪判据与失败上报（见 [`../docs/handoff-protocol.md`](../docs/handoff-protocol.md)）， 桌面进程崩溃时你会拿到 `launch_failed` + 信号/日志路径，不会拿到假成功。 Windows 版 Codex 的默认沙箱里桌面应用起不来：会拿到 `sandboxed_launch`（CLI 不拉进程）， 在沙箱外重跑同一条命令即可。 ### 工作区为什么会弹一次确认 `project_path` 是模型给的候选，不是权限。Tavotto 的 `RootAuthority` 按固定顺序取 可信边界：显式 `TAVOTTO_MCP_ROOTS` → host 声明的 MCP Roots（旧协议兼容）→ Codex 原生确认框里由用户批准的精确目录 → host workspace 环境变量 → 安全 cwd。 当前 host 若声明 `elicitation` 而没有声明 Roots，第一次打开请传**绝对、已存在**的 项目路径。确认框会显示 realpath，默认不批准；只有用户明确接受后，这一个目录才在 当前 MCP 连接内生效。取消/拒绝/超时都会 fail-closed，代理也会收到“不要自动循环 重试”的机器可读错误。重新 initialize/重启 server 自动清掉授权。文件系统根、插件 缓存目录、远程 URI 与不存在的路径永远不能通过这条路。 MCP Roots 自协议版本 2026-07-28 起已弃用，所以它保留为 compatibility path， 不是长期唯一入口。完整不变式见 [ADR 0009](../docs/adr/0009-codex-workspace-root-authority.md)。 ## 插件自己的更新 Codex 不会替插件检查更新，所以插件自己查：每 24 小时最多一次，1.5 秒超时， 网络不通就用上次的答案、不报错也不拖慢出图。有新版时交接结果里多一个 `update` 字段，同时往 stderr 写一句人话——**stdout 永远只有那一行 JSON**。 **只提醒，不下载、不安装。** 看到提醒后自己执行： ```bash codex plugin marketplace upgrade tavotto # 然后重载 Codex ``` 显式查一次（忽略缓存）： ```bash python3 skills/tavotto-figure/scripts/update_check.py --json --force ``` 两个开关：`TAVOTTO_UPDATE_URL`（换清单地址，自建分发/内网镜像用）、 `TAVOTTO_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=1`（完全关掉，一个包都不发）。 ## 怎么用 ### 画图前：开工三问与偏好 会话里第一次让 Codex 画图（@Tavotto / 隐式触发技能）时，它会先跑一次 `tavotto_health` 体检（健康就直接干活，**不做任何安装或升级**；工具缺失 / 引擎不可用时按技能里的恢复路径引导），然后用提问工具确认三件事：**画幅宽度** （单栏 8 cm / 双栏 15 cm，拿不准时按任务推荐）、**字体**（选项含 Times New Roman 与 Arial）、**图例加不加框**。回答里说「记住」，答案会写进 用户配置目录的 `codex-plugin-figure-prefs.json`，下次不再问；反悔时说一声 或用 `python3 skills/tavotto-figure/scripts/prefs.py --unset <键>` 退回。 出图纪律（`lab-publication-v1` 之外的几条硬默认）：宽度只出 8 cm / 15 cm 两档、最终有效字号不低于 8 pt、刻度朝内且只留主刻度、轴标题加粗、多子图在 matplotlib 里拼成 15 cm 主图且每个子图的 x/y 轴各自标全（轴标题 + 刻度， 不用 sharex/sharey 共享）；背景色块、指数据的 箭头、说明文字这类效果**用户点头才加**。Tavotto 报错或表现不及预期时， Codex 会整理一份可复现的 issue 草稿，经你允许后提交到 。 ### 打开画布 让 Codex 调 `tavotto_open_figure`，给它一个图库目录、脚本或产物路径： ``` 用 Tavotto 打开 figures/Fig1_kinetics.pdf ``` 如果 health 里还没有可信根，第一次请让 Codex 传绝对路径并核对原生确认框；确认后 同一连接里的相对路径才有稳定基准。非交互 `codex exec` 会取消确认，这是安全行为， 不是 Desktop 正向验收。 支持 UI 的 host 会开出一块全屏画布（复杂编辑放不进 inline 卡片）；不支持的 host （Codex CLI 等）则拿到同一份结构化数据，接着用工具改图。 ### 改图 画布里直接拖、直接改：图例位置、图内文字（内容/字号/字体/颜色/粗细/位置）、 线宽颜色线型 marker、刻度朝向与字号、子图位置大小、箭头端点、多图拼版与 (a)(b) 标签、 对齐分布。每一次改动都会调 `tavotto_apply_overrides`，画布用**服务端返回的** manifest/SVG 更新——iframe 里不保存业务状态。 不用画布也可以，直接让 Codex 调： ``` 把图例挪到右下角，刻度改成朝内，线宽统一到 0.75pt ``` > **patches 是全量列表语义**：每次都发完整的一份，列表里没有的 `(gid, prop)` 会自动 > 恢复成脚本原始值。这也是撤销的基础，**不要发增量**。 ### 跑预检 `tavotto_preflight` 按出版规范体检：页面宽度与比例、**最终有效字号**（按面板缩放折算， 不是原始 matplotlib 字号）、字体与中文 fallback、刻度朝向、封闭坐标轴、图例边框、 线宽档位、色系、位图 DPI、越界与重叠、隐藏对象、过期渲染、未应用的 override。 结果分四档： | 等级 | 含义 | | --- | --- | | `errors` | **默认阻止导出**；要带着它导出必须用户明确要求 | | `warnings` | 放行，但会摆出来 | | `not_verifiable` | **我们查不了**（如外部位图内部的文字字号），需要人工确认；写进 proof | | `suggestions` | 建议（误差棒、置信带、色系语义这类，绝不替你裁决） | ### 导出 `tavotto_export` **先跑一遍预检**，有 `errors` 且没有 `explicit_confirm` 时一张图都不出。 PDF/SVG/EPS 是真矢量（EPS 不支持透明度），PNG/TIFF 按给定 dpi 栅格化（TIFF 无损 Deflate 压缩）， 同时写一份 proof report（规范身份 + 全部检查结果 + 是否强制导出）。缺省落在 `<项目>/tavottofile/export/`——与 Tavotto 画布导出同一个 目录规则。 ### 改了脚本之后：刷新项目 Codex 修改、新建、重命名或删除绘图脚本之后调 `tavotto_refresh_project`（技能里已写进 流程末尾）。它让 Tavotto 重新读这个项目：静态合并脚本注册表、比对素材、算每张图的接入 状态，并把结果推给**正在运行的 Tavotto 界面**——用户不需要手动刷新，也不需要重启。 返回哪些脚本 / 图变了、哪些图现在可编辑（`readiness.panels[].status`）。 * **不是运行脚本的工具**：不 probe、不执行任何用户代码。`needs_probe` 的图要用户在 Tavotto 里点「试运行并连接」；`conflict` 的图不自动裁决。 * 项目来自当前授权：优先传 `session_id`（`tavotto_open_figure` 回来的），或传一个已授权 工作区内的 `project_path`；两者都不传时用唯一有会话的项目。 * `delivered: app` = 运行中的 Tavotto 已同步（浏览器模式的实例，`127.0.0.1:5089`）； `delivered: local` = Tavotto 没开着（或是桌面版——它的端口不落盘），刷新已在本地完成， 下次打开项目时自动生效；桌面版开着时由它自己的 watcher 在两秒内跟上。 * 结果里没有绝对路径：项目是短 id，脚本 / 图是项目相对名。 ### 想彻底确认 `tavotto_verify_replay` 起一个一次性 worker 从零重放同一组 patches，把两份 manifest 逐元素比几何。它回答的是「你现在看到的 == 重开这张图会得到的」。会重跑一遍脚本 （heavy 的图是分钟级），所以不是每次都要。 ### 回到 Tavotto 桌面窗口 多图拼版、画布标注、版本历史、写回原始文件这些留在 Tavotto 本体。跑技能自带的： ``` python3 skills/tavotto-figure/scripts/handoff.py figures/fig_removal_rate.py ``` ## 哪些改动必须回 Python 代码 鼠标改的是 artist 属性；**需要重建图形结构的一律回代码**： * 数据本身、单位换算、拟合、筛选 * 坐标范围与刻度尺度（`set_xlim/ylim`、对数坐标、刻度定位器） * 加/删曲线、加/删子图、`sharex` 关系、colorbar 方向 * `annotate()` 的箭头端点（注释机制每帧重定位，拖完下一帧就弹回） 完整清单见 [`skills/tavotto-figure/references/compatibility.md`](skills/tavotto-figure/references/compatibility.md)。 画布遇到给不出结构化控件的属性时会**明说「这条得回代码改」**，不会造一个点了没用的开关。 ## 出版规范 profile 规范是一份**版本化的 JSON**，Python 与 TypeScript 读的是同一个文件： `src/tavotto/profiles/publication.json`（随 Tavotto 的 wheel 分发）。 默认 `lab-publication-v1`： | 项 | 值 | | --- | --- | | 单栏 / 双栏宽 | 80 mm / 150 mm（容差 0.5 mm） | | 允许比例 | 16:9、4:3、1:1 | | 默认字号 | 9 pt | | 最终有效字号下限 | **不低于 8 pt**（ADR 0029 起只有这一个数，§6b 起含等号） | | 位图最低 DPI | 300 | | 矢量格式 | PDF、SVG | | 拉丁字体 | Times New Roman（+ 明确的中文 fallback） | | 线宽档位 | 0.5 / 0.75 / 1.0 / 1.5 pt | | 坐标轴 | 封闭、刻度朝内、主刻度为主、标题写成 `Title (unit)` | | 图例 | 无边框 | | 色系 | Scientific colour maps，按 sequential / diverging / categorical 语义选 | **期刊自定义尺寸**不用新建 profile，给一份覆盖即可（只覆盖点名的键，其余继承）： ```json { "profile_id": "lab-publication-v1", "journal": { "widths_mm": { "double": 178 } } } ``` `tavotto_open_figure` / `tavotto_preflight` / `tavotto_export` 都接 `profile_id` 与 `journal`。覆盖结果会写进 proof report——「这张图按哪套规矩过的检」必须能读回来。 要整套换掉（企业/期刊自带一份规范文件）：设 `TAVOTTO_PROFILES_FILE` 指向你的 JSON。 ## 结构 ``` codex-plugin/ ├── .codex-plugin/plugin.json # 插件清单（Codex 认的唯一入口） ├── codex.mcp.json # Codex 的 MCP ├── tavotto_mcp/ # 协议 + 引擎桥（纯标准库 + tavotto 本体） │ │ ├── rpc.py # JSON-RPC over stdio（stdout 归协议独占） │ │ ├── server.py # initialize / tools / resources │ │ ├── bridge.py # 会话、路径范围、渲染、预检、导出 │ │ └── 按需读取的细则（SKILL.md 里写明何时读哪份） │ ├── first-run-and-recovery.md # 安装 / provision / 错误码 / 新会话规则 │ ├── figure-contract.md # 同目录 / 静态产物名 / main() / 模板 │ ├── publication-style.md # 尺寸字号 / 克制 / 组图 │ ├── →（必要时）跑脚本 → 唤起 Tavotto ``` 交接的真正实现在 Tavotto 主体里（`tavotto open`，见 `src/tavotto/engine/handoff.py`）：路径解析、注册表合并、唤起桌面还是浏览器 全在那边裁决，插件不做第二套判断。 插件里唯一的一处「判断」是**怎么找到那条命令行**（上面那六步）。它是 `src/tavotto/engine/locate.py` 的镜像——插件跑在用户机器上，import 不到 tavotto，这份重复无法避免；能避免的是两边悄悄漂开，所以 `tests/test_install_locate.py::test_plugin_mirrors_the_locator` 在一整张环境 矩阵上逐条比对两侧的输出。改一边必须同步另一边。 ## 本地开发 ```bash # 画布（改了 web/src 就得重跑；CI 有门禁盯着产物是否同步） python scripts/build_mcp_widget.py python scripts/build_mcp_widget.py --check # MCP server 自检（不连 host 也能看到它是活的） python codex-plugin/mcp/server.py --self-check # 根权威 + 双向协议 + 真 stdio + 真渲染链路 .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_mcp_roots.py tests/test_mcp_server.py \ tests/test_mcp_stdio.py tests/test_mcp_roundtrip.py ``` 环境变量： | 变量 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `TAVOTTO_MCP_ROOTS` | 允许打开的项目根（`os.pathsep` 分隔）。**越界一律拒** | | `TAVOTTO_MCP_WORKSPACE` | 没设 `TAVOTTO_MCP_ROOTS` 时的工作区目录（宿主的 `CODEX_WORKSPACE_ROOT` 等同样认） | | `TAVOTTO_CLI` | 指向 tavotto 可执行文件（启动器据此找解释器） | | `TAVOTTO_MCP_WIDGET` | 指向另一份画布 HTML（边改边试） | | `TAVOTTO_PROFILES_FILE` | 指向另一份出版规范 JSON | **允许打开的目录怎么定**（按顺序，第一个权威来源命中就用它）： `TAVOTTO_MCP_ROOTS` → host 明确声明后由 `roots/list` 返回的本地目录 → 用户经 MCP elicitation 批准、只活在本连接内的精确目录 → 宿主传过来的工作区变量 （`TAVOTTO_MCP_WORKSPACE` / `CODEX_WORKSPACE_ROOT` / `CODEX_PROJECT_ROOT` / `CODEX_WORKSPACE_DIR`）→ 进程 cwd，**且它不在插件包自己的目录里**。装好的插件 cwd 正是插件目录，拿它当边界会把每张用户图判成越界。一个都拿不到时**按失败原因 分档**返回——不静默放行，也不把模型参数当权限。 **失败分档**（每档一个稳定 `code` + 一个 `disposition` + 一句 `recovery`）： 用户看着确认框拒绝是 `workspace_confirmation_declined`（`ask_user_again`）； 宿主声明了 `elicitation`/`roots` 却**没把框送到用户面前**（超时、断开）是 `workspace_confirmation_no_response` / `workspace_roots_no_response` （`fix_host_wiring`——这不是用户拒绝，再点也不会有提示，去查宿主接线）； 宿主不弹框、**当场替用户回了拒绝**（快过任何人能作答，或回应里标着 `approvals_reviewer: auto_review`）是 `workspace_confirmation_auto_declined` （同样 `fix_host_wiring`：Codex 的「完全访问」权限与 `codex exec` 都会这样， 把权限切到「请求批准」后重新打开即可弹框）； 路径越界是 `path_out_of_scope`（`narrow_the_path`，错误里列出允许的根）； 宿主既没给目录也不支持确认是 `no_workspace_root`（`configure_roots`，直接给 `TAVOTTO_MCP_ROOTS` 的用法）。给出的目录是整个用户主目录（或它的上级）是 `workspace_root_too_broad` （`configure_roots`：在具体项目目录里启动宿主，或设 `TAVOTTO_MCP_ROOTS`）。`tavotto_health` 的 `root_authority.authorization` 不用先失败一次就能看到当前这一档。 ## 已知限制 **启动命令是插件自带的 `./mcp/launch`（#266）。** Codex 的 MCP 配置（`codex.mcp.json`）只有一个 `command` 字符串、没有按平台分支，而 Windows 上 `python3.exe` 常常只是 Microsoft Store 的执行别名存根（macOS 12.3 起又没有 `python`，两边没有通用的名字）。所以插件自带一对 启动器：POSIX 上 Codex 执行 `mcp/launch`，它就是 `exec python3 "$@"`；Windows 上 Codex 按 PATHEXT 把 `./mcp/launch` 解析成同目录的 `mcp/launch.cmd`，它依次**真跑** `TAVOTTO_MCP_PYTHON`、插件自管环境、`py -3`、PATH 上的 `python` / `python3`、 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Python\Python3*`，跳过起不来的（商店别名），再把参数原样 交给第一个能跑的。仍然「插件装上了，但一个工具都看不见」时（这台 Windows 上一个能跑 的 Python 都没有），跑 `tavotto codex install` 把命令钉到一个验证过的解释器。 插件 0.17.0 在 Windows 上用的是 sh / cmd 同一文件的双语启动器：cmd 把它第一行的 shebang 回显进 stdout，真 Codex Desktop 上握手因此失败、一个工具都没有（引擎装好了也 一样）。这一版起拆成两个文件、`launch.cmd` 第一行就是 `@echo off`；还停在 0.17.0 的 Windows 用户升级插件（`codex plugin marketplace upgrade tavotto`）后新开会话即可。 `tavotto codex install` 的 interpreter 步从这一版引擎起也认得这种形状：stdout 在体检 JSON 之外多出任何一行都判「起不来」，把已装副本钉到一个验证过的解释器（旧引擎只看最后一行是不是 JSON，会把它判成起得来）。 （`pipx install tavotto` 那条已经好了：启动器会去读 Windows console script `.exe` 里嵌着的 shebang，找到 pipx venv 的解释器。） ## 验证过什么、没验证什么 **MCP App 画布在真实 Codex Desktop 里的 iframe 渲染，验收做过一次，不是每个版本都做。** 2026-08-24 的记录（macOS 26.6.1，Codex Desktop 26.818.41509，codex-cli 0.149.1， 引擎与插件 0.9.2）在 [`docs/acceptance/codex-desktop-canvas.md`](../docs/acceptance/codex-desktop-canvas.md)： 真实握手、拒绝授权时不建会话、批准后任务内出现画布并能拖动回传。**当前发行版 （v0.15.0）没有重做这次验收**——历史通过不等于当前版本、当前 Codex 版本或所有 系统都通过；要说「画布在 Desktop 里可用」，先按那份文档的步骤再跑一遍并留证据。 每个版本都在跑的自动化是： * MCP 协议层（`initialize` / `tools/list` / `tools/call` / `resources/list` / `resources/read`）在真 stdio 上跑通，见 `tests/test_mcp_roundtrip.py`； * 九个工具在**没有 UI** 的情况下能走完 打开 → 改图 → 预检 → 导出 → 关闭； * 画布逻辑（会话灌入、拖动→override→manifest 更新、错误透出、不建第二套状态） 在 vitest 里有用例，见 `web/src/mcp/session.test.ts`； * 资源声明形状（`text/html;profile=mcp-app`、`_meta.ui.resourceUri`、空 CSP）有断言。 自动化覆盖不到的是「Codex 真的把这块 HTML 塞进 iframe 并跑起来、握手成功、拖动能 回到 server」这一整条——只有真实 Desktop 验收能回答。装上插件后如果画布不出现， 工具照常可用（open/apply 的返回里会带 `canvas_ui` 说明画布为什么没出现）——那正是 fallback 的设计目的。 技术细节与取舍见 [ADR 0006](../docs/adr/0006-codex-mcp-app-and-publication-profile.md)。 工作区授权见 [ADR 0009](../docs/adr/0009-codex-workspace-root-authority.md)，真实桌面 # Tavotto: make AI-drawn research figures publication-ready **AI drew your research figure. Tavotto™ makes it publication-ready.** Tavotto is a free, open-source tool for finishing scientific figures: it opens the figure that an AI assistant or your own Python script already drew (matplotlib today), and you change titles, legends, curves and the page layout on a canvas. The script stays untouched, every edit is saved separately, and before export the figure is checked against a publication profile (font floor, column width, dpi).

## Download


Needs macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon, macOS 15+ on Intel, or Windows x64 (Windows on ARM is neither built nor verified). Linux runs from PyPI (beta). What is supported is decided in one place, docs/support-matrix.json.

## Get started ### Desktop app in three steps 1. **Install it.** Open the `.dmg` or run the `.exe` from the buttons above. The installer carries its own Python with numpy, matplotlib, pandas, scipy, seaborn and Pillow, so you do not install Python. The download is about 195 MB on macOS and 89 MB on Windows. 2. **Open your figures.** Drag a matplotlib script (`.py`) onto the window, or open the folder that holds your figure scripts. The home page also offers a guided example. 3. **Edit and export.** Double-click a panel to edit inside it, arrange panels on the page, then press Export. The preflight runs before anything is written. On Windows, an unsigned installer makes SmartScreen show a prompt on first run: choose *More info → Run anyway*, or check the file against `SHA256SUMS.txt` on the release page first. More: [installation details](docs/guide/install-advanced.md). ### Use it from an AI coding assistant With the desktop app installed, open **Settings → Figure assistants → Connect AI editors** and press **Connect** on your editor's row; the first time, it asks which project folder the editor may work in. | Assistant | With the desktop app | Without it | | --- | --- | --- | | Codex | Connect | [Codex plugin](#using-tavotto-in-codex-plugin) | | Claude Code, WorkBuddy | Connect | [Plugin (Beta)](docs/guide/ai-hosts.md#using-tavotto-with-claude-code-beta) | | Cursor, VS Code, Trae, ZCode, Claude Desktop | Connect | [Config generator (experimental)](docs/guide/ai-hosts.md#using-tavotto-from-other-ai-editors-and-clients-experimental) | | DeepSeek Harness, MiniMax Code | Not yet | [Bundle (Beta) or config generator](docs/guide/ai-hosts.md#using-tavotto-with-deepseek-harness-beta) | ### pip, Linux and servers ```sh pipx install "tavotto[worker]" tavotto ``` Your browser opens at `http://127.0.0.1:5089`. It needs Python 3.10 or later; on an older Python, `uv tool install --python 3.12 "tavotto[worker]"` fetches one. `tavotto --figures ` opens a figure folder directly. More (uv, SSH to a remote server, your own Python environment): [installation details](docs/guide/install-advanced.md). In mainland China, downloads from PyPI can stall; install from a domestic mirror instead: ```sh pipx install "tavotto[worker]" --index-url https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/ ``` ## What it does ### Edit inside the figure Double-click a panel and Tavotto runs your script once and keeps the matplotlib `Figure` in memory. Pick the title, a tick, a curve, the legend or an arrow from the tree or on the canvas, then change its size, colour, dash pattern or position; dragging follows the cursor, and matplotlib runs once when you let go. [What can be edited](docs/guide/editing-reference.md). ![Editing inside figure (a): the element tree on the left, the whole page in view with the title selected and its size, bold and italic controls above it, and font, size and colour on the right.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tavotto/Tavotto/main/assets/readme/canvas-edit.png) ### Lay out several figures on one page Place panels on a page measured in millimetres at the size their script drew them, snap and align them, bind them into rows and grids, add (a)(b)(c) labels, and draw arrows, scale bars and zoom boxes on top. ![Layout mode: figures (a), (b) and (c) arranged on a 150 × 125 mm page, with (a) selected and its X, Y, W, H in millimetres on the right.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tavotto/Tavotto/main/assets/readme/layout.png) ### Check and export for submission Export writes PDF with real vector text, plus PNG, TIFF and SVG (PNG and TIFF at 300 to 1200 ppi; EPS too when you export a single figure that has a script). Alongside, the figure is checked against a publication profile at its final physical size: text under the font floor, the wrong column width, low-dpi rasters. Findings are sorted into to fix, to review, not verifiable and suggestions. They never lock the Export button; anything still unresolved is recorded in a style-check report written with the files. [Formats, levels and profile](docs/guide/export-and-preflight.md). ![The export dialog: output as whole page or each figure, PDF and PNG at 600 ppi, and the pre-export checks against the default spec showing 1 to review and 3 not verifiable.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tavotto/Tavotto/main/assets/readme/preflight.png) ### Connect your own AI to change the figure The assistant panel edits the script for you ("move the legend to the top left, 7 pt"). Connect a ChatGPT (Codex) or Claude subscription, an API key from DeepSeek, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, MiniMax, Alibaba Bailian, OpenAI or Anthropic and others, or any compatible custom endpoint. Your script is snapshotted first, you see the diff, and one click reverts it. This is the only path that touches your script, and you have to start it. ![The Connect an AI dialog: DeepSeek, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, MiniMax and Alibaba Bailian, each with a Connect button, and More AI… below.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tavotto/Tavotto/main/assets/readme/connect-ai.png) ### Open a script in the environment it already runs in Tavotto looks for the conda, venv or system Python your script was written for and runs it there. A package it cannot find is named, and your own environments are never modified. From a terminal, `tavotto run -- python figure.py` attaches to figures made by the command you already use ([Beta](docs/compatibility/tavotto-run.md)). ![After running a linked script: the asset library shows fig1_kinetics.py as Captured 1 figure, and the figure it produced sits on the canvas, with its position, size and original size on the right.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tavotto/Tavotto/main/assets/readme/run-script.png) ### Go back to any earlier layout The layout timeline keeps a node automatically after you pause editing (at most one every two minutes) and on export, write-back, save, and project open or close. Name the ones you want to keep, compare a node with the current canvas, and restore it; the state before the restore is saved too. ![The Timeline tab in the right column listing two named moments, "Three panels" and "Bottom row 52 mm", above "Project opened".](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tavotto/Tavotto/main/assets/readme/timeline.png) ## Why use it | | Edit the script and re-run | Finish in a vector editor | Tavotto | |---|---|---|---| | Move a legend by 3 mm | Change a number, run, look, repeat | Drag it | Drag it | | Knows it is a legend, not paths | In code | No | Yes: title, legend, ticks, series, colourbar | | Edits survive the next data update | Yes | No, the hand-made layout is lost | Yes, replayed onto a fresh run | | Several panels on a page in mm | By hand in code | Yes | Yes | | Journal rules checked before export | No | No | Yes | A vector editor is the more powerful drawing tool. It does not know that the thing you clicked is a legend, and it cuts the figure off from the code that drew it. ## Common questions **Can I edit a PDF that matplotlib generated?** Yes, when the script that produced it is next to it: `tavotto open figures/Fig1.pdf` matches it to the script in the same project, re-runs it and lets you edit the figure itself, not a flattened picture. A PDF with no script in its project folder can still be placed on a page, arranged, annotated and exported, but not edited inside. **Does Tavotto change my script?** No. Edits are stored as overrides in the layout and replayed onto a fresh run. "Write back to the original file" is an explicit action, and it can be locked off per project. The optional AI assistant is the other way your script can change, and only when you ask. **Is my data uploaded?** No. Rendering, layout and export run on your machine. Tavotto makes two requests on its own: a daily update check, and anonymous usage statistics that are off until you opt in. If you connect an AI, your request goes to that AI, through its command-line tool or straight to its API, and nowhere else. See [Privacy](#privacy). **Does it work with figures written by Claude, Codex or ChatGPT?** Yes. Any matplotlib script works, including seaborn and pandas plots. For agents, keep the script and its output in one folder and save the output as vector PDF; the plugin teaches the agent this shape. **Do I need to install Python?** Not for the desktop app, which carries its own.
